# Files

## File: .cursor/rules/tdd.mdc
````
---
description: Test-driven development for Kannada Quest — red-green slices at documented seams
alwaysApply: true
---

# TDD (Kannada Quest)

Follow **test-driven development** for features, behavior changes, and bug fixes unless the user asks for docs-only or exploratory work.

## Loop

1. **Red** — Write one failing test at a agreed **seam** (public interface).
2. **Green** — Implement the minimum code to pass.
3. **Next slice** — Repeat; avoid writing a large test suite before implementation.

Refactoring after green is fine; do not skip red on new behavior.

## Seams in this repo

| Seam | Location | Runner |
|------|----------|--------|
| Domain rules (SM-2, answers, XP, content validation) | `src/domain/**`, `tests/unit/*.test.ts` | `npm run test` |
| Curriculum bundle contracts | `src/domain/content/validate.ts`, `content/validate` tests | `npm run test`, `npm run content:validate` |
| Spec → bundle build | `scripts/curriculum/load.py`, `assemble.py` | Add/harden tests when changing builder behavior |
| Persistence & backup | `src-tauri/src/**` | `cd src-tauri && cargo test` |

Prefer **domain tests** over testing React components unless the UI is the only observable behavior.

## Rules

- Test through **public APIs** (`src/domain` exports, Tauri command contracts, validation functions) — not private helpers or implementation details.
- Expected values come from the **spec or a known-good example**, not by re-copying production logic into the test.
- One vertical slice at a time: one test → one change → pass.
- Before finishing, run **`npm run test`** and relevant **`cargo test`** (and **`npm run content:validate`** when curriculum changes).

Authoritative detail: [`docs/constitution/techstack.md`](docs/constitution/techstack.md) § Testing and TDD.
````

## File: content/schemas/learning-item.schema.json
````json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "LearningItem",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "id",
    "kannada_text",
    "transliteration",
    "english_meaning",
    "validation_status"
  ],
  "properties": {
    "id": { "type": "string", "pattern": "^[a-z0-9-]+$" },
    "kannada_text": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "transliteration": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "english_meaning": { "type": "string", "minLength": 1 },
    "literal_translation": { "type": "string" },
    "context_note": { "type": "string" },
    "register": { "enum": ["formal", "informal", "neutral"] },
    "dialect": { "type": "string" },
    "tags": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "difficulty": { "type": "integer", "minimum": 1, "maximum": 5 },
    "accepted_answers": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "string" } },
    "validation_status": { "enum": ["draft", "reviewed", "approved"] },
    "content_version": { "type": "integer" }
  },
  "additionalProperties": false
}
````

## File: docs/features/ai-grammar-insights.md
````markdown
# Real AI grammar insights (opt-in)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Status | Planned |
| Roadmap | [Phase 9](../constitution/roadmap.md#phase-9--optional-intelligence) |
| Priority | P3 |

## Learner outcome

“When I tap ‘Explain grammar,’ I get a short, accurate note about *sari* or word order—clearly labeled as AI help, not the official phrase meaning.”

## Principles

- **Optional intelligence** — never replaces canonical phrase text in `content/`.
- **Privacy** — no learner recordings off-device; grammar request uses phrase context already on screen.

## Current state

- `AIContentProvider` in `src/services/ai/types.ts` with `explainGrammar`, variations, exercise generation.
- `MockAIContentProvider` in dev; `UnconfiguredAIProvider` when `VITE_AI_PROVIDER=unconfigured`.
- Phrase detail: `loadGrammarExplanation()` with brittle `grammarPatternForItem` id heuristic.

## In scope

- User-visible toggle: “Grammar insights” off by default in production builds.
- Real provider behind env-selected backend URL or on-device boundary (**no API keys in client** per techstack).
- UI labels: “AI explanation” vs canonical fields (Kannada, transliteration, English).
- Grounding: send only `patternId`, `exampleItemIds`, and canonical strings from DB—not free-form user text.
- Offline: show cached explanation per pattern if previously fetched (optional v1); otherwise friendly disabled state.

## Out of scope

- `generatePhraseVariations` / `generateExercises` in production without editorial workflow.
- Autonomous curriculum generation.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Production build with AI off: button hidden or shows “Not available in this build.”
- [ ] With AI on: explanation loads for at least 3 patterns wired in content metadata (replace id heuristic).
- [ ] Network failure does not block phrase detail or audio.
- [ ] Security review: no secrets in bundle; request payload documented.

## Dependencies

- Content: add explicit `grammar_pattern_id` on items or patterns table in JSON spec.
- Optional small backend repo or serverless function (out of band).

## Future (not v1)

- Exercise generation for authors only (internal tooling).
- Phrase variation drafts with `validationStatus: draft` never shown to learners until approved.
````

## File: docs/features/guided-onboarding.md
````markdown
# Guided onboarding & goals

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Status | Planned |
| Roadmap | Cross-cutting |
| Priority | P4 |

## Learner outcome

“On day one I picked a realistic daily goal and knew whether I already read Kannada script or need transliteration emphasis.”

## Principles

- **Multimodal clarity** — meet learners where they are (script literacy).
- **Retention by design** — goal setting ties to streaks already on Home.

## Current state

- `OnboardingScreen`: welcome copy + optional name → `completeOnboarding`.
- Daily goal defaults in DB; editable only in Settings (hard to discover).

## In scope

- 2–3 step onboarding (single screen or stepped):
  1. Welcome + name (keep optional).
  2. Daily goal preset chips (e.g. 15 / 30 / 50 XP) with plain-language time estimate.
  3. Optional: “I can read Kannada script” toggle → persisted preference for UI emphasis (transliteration prominence in exercises) — **only if** exercise renderer can honor flag without large refactor.
- Write goal via same API as Settings (`updateLearnerProfile`).

## Out of scope

- Placement test that skips units (risks holes in survival path).
- Social sign-in.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] First launch sets daily goal before Home; streak logic uses chosen value.
- [ ] Skip path still works (defaults to current 50 XP).
- [ ] Onboarding completion flag unchanged for returning users.

## Dependencies

- [settings-discoverability.md](./settings-discoverability.md) if goal editing stays in Settings for changes later.
- Schema: may only need `learner_profile` fields already present; script preference may need migration if added.
````

## File: docs/features/human-phrase-audio.md
````markdown
# Human / studio phrase audio

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Status | Planned |
| Roadmap | Phase 7 |
| Priority | P1 |

## Learner outcome

“The voices sound like real Bengaluru Kannada, not robotic TTS, especially for greetings and high-traffic phrases.”

## Principles

- **Bengaluru Kannada** — natural prosody matters for trust.
- **Content as a product** — audio is versioned alongside phrases; validation in CI.

## Current state

- `npm run content:build` generates WAV via macOS TTS (Soumya) for bulk assets.
- `course.json` supports `extra_audio_assets` with `source: "ai"` / review metadata.
- Import path maps files into `audio_assets` on first launch.

## In scope

- Editorial priority list: Unit 1–4 + high-frequency items (greetings, travel, food).
- WAV format consistency (sample rate, duration_ms) enforced by `content:validate`.
- Replace or supplement TTS files while keeping stable `learning_item_id` / asset IDs.
- Document recording guidelines (pace, formal vs spoken note in content spec).

## Out of scope

- Per-learner custom voices.
- Dynamic TTS at runtime for all phrases.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] At least N approved human recordings (target TBD, suggest 30+) pass validation and ship in bundle.
- [ ] Phrase detail and exercises prefer human asset when `review_status: approved`.
- [ ] Fallback to existing TTS asset when human file missing (no broken playback).

## Dependencies

- Content version bump in `course.json`.
- Optional: extend validator to flag `source: human` vs `tts` for QA reports.
````

## File: docs/features/learn-path-ux.md
````markdown
# Unit map & learning path UX

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Status | Planned |
| Roadmap | Cross-cutting (curriculum scale) |
| Priority | P4 |

## Learner outcome

“I see how units fit together—greetings before shopping—and which lesson to do next in the path.”

## Principles

- **Practical-first** — situations grouped visibly, not a flat lesson grid only.

## Current state

- `LearnScreen`: level chips + flat lesson list with completion and duration.
- Unit metadata exists in content specs (`unit-1-greetings.json`, etc.) but UI does not group by unit.

## In scope

- Group lessons under unit titles with short unit descriptions from specs.
- Visual “recommended next” lesson (first incomplete in ordinal order).
- Optional lock icon **off** by default (mission: no punitive gating); optional soft suggestion only.

## Out of scope

- Skill tree gamification, leagues, hearts/lives.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 13 units visible for Level 1 with correct lesson ordering.
- [ ] Tapping lesson still opens existing `LessonPlayerScreen`.
- [ ] iPad: two-column unit cards if space allows.

## Dependencies

- IPC: ensure `listLessonsForLevel` returns `unit_id` / `unit_title` or fetch unit list command.
- Content specs already carry unit structure — prefer import-time denormalization into DB for simple queries.
````

## File: docs/features/personal-release-cadence.md
````markdown
# Personal release cadence (~7 days)

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Status | Active |
| Audience | Solo developer (personal use only) |
| Priority | P0 (governs all other priorities) |

## Intent

Kannada Quest is built and run **for one learner: you**. There is no App Store or public distribution goal. You refresh the app on a **roughly weekly** cycle from this repo—new curriculum, fixes, or UI—while keeping progress on device whenever possible.

## What “publish” means here

| Channel | Use |
|---------|-----|
| **Desktop** | `npm run tauri dev` for daily study; `npm run test` before merge |
| **iOS (your devices)** | `npm run ios:dev` / device build with your signing team |
| **Not in scope** | TestFlight, App Store, store assets, external testers |

App Store work is **deferred**: see [ios-app-store-release.md](./ios-app-store-release.md) (archived brief).

## Recommended weekly loop

1. **Content** — edit specs under `content/`, run `npm run content:validate` (and `content:build` on macOS if audio changed).
2. **Quality** — `npm run test` and `cd src-tauri && cargo test`.
3. **Version** — bump app version in Tauri config if binary changed; bump `content_version` in `course.json` if curriculum changed.
4. **Install** — build/install to the device you actually practice on.
5. **Data** — export backup before risky schema or content experiments (`Progress` → Export backup).

## Progress across weekly installs

Today, bundled curriculum imports when the DB is **empty** only. Reinstalling the app or wiping data re-imports content but **loses** learner state unless you restore a backup.

For a 7-day rhythm, prioritize:

| Approach | When |
|----------|------|
| **Backup → update app → restore** | Safe default until content-only import exists |
| **Same DB file** (dev: don’t wipe `learner.sqlite`) | Desktop practice between iOS rebuilds |
| **Content update without reinstall** | [content-updates.md](./content-updates.md) — highest-value engineering for weekly publishes |

## Priority stack (personal use)

1. **Trust your data** — backup/restore, SM-2, evaluation tests stay green.
2. **Weekly content velocity** — validators, content version, import story (CLI or pack).
3. **Device practice quality** — audio/recording on *your* phone ([native-ios-audio.md](./native-ios-audio.md)).
4. **Learning UX** — search, unit map, onboarding tweaks as *you* feel friction.
5. **AI grammar** — only if you wire a backend you control; mock is enough for solo use.

## Acceptance criteria (cadence)

- [ ] Documented in one place: minimum commands for “Tuesday content push” vs “Friday app rebuild”.
- [ ] You can recover from a bad week via backup without re-doing mastered phrases.
- [ ] Optional: scripted checklist in repo (`scripts/weekly-release.sh` or Makefile target) — add when repetitive.
````

````markdown
# Phrase search & browse

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Status | Planned |
| Roadmap | Cross-cutting (supports Phase 8 scale) |
| Priority | P4 |

## Learner outcome

“Before a cab ride I can search ‘airport’ or ‘how much’ and practice the phrases I need.”

## Principles

- **Practical-first** — situation lookup beats scrolling 110+ items across units.
- **Offline-first** — search index local after import.

## Current state

- Phrase detail at `/phrase/:itemId` exists.
- Progress shows counts only; no global phrase list in UI.
- IPC likely needs `search_learning_items` or filter on existing list command (verify in `src-tauri/src/commands/curriculum.rs`).

## In scope

- Search by English, transliteration, and Kannada substring (normalized).
- Filter chips: unit, mastery status (`new` / `learning` / `mastered`).
- Result row → existing `PhraseDetailScreen`.
- Empty state when no matches.

## Out of scope

- Full-text search across lesson narrative JSON.
- Semantic / embedding search (unless on-device and offline).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Search works in airplane mode after first launch.
- [ ] Performance acceptable for 500+ items (target for Level 1+2).
- [ ] Kannada script rendering in results matches lesson player.

## Dependencies

- Optional DB index migration for `english_meaning`, `transliteration`, `kannada_text`.
- More valuable after [level-2-curriculum.md](./level-2-curriculum.md).
````

## File: docs/features/README.md
````markdown
# Feature planning

This folder turns [product vision](../vision.md), [mission](../constitution/mission.md), and [roadmap](../constitution/roadmap.md) into **buildable feature briefs**. Each brief states learner value, scope, alignment with constitution principles, and acceptance criteria.

## Operating mode (solo, personal)

- **No App Store** — you ship to yourself from this repo about **every 7 days**.
- **Governance doc:** [personal-release-cadence.md](./personal-release-cadence.md)
- App Store brief is [deferred](./ios-app-store-release.md).

## How to use

1. Pick work from the **priority backlog** below (same order as [roadmap prioritization](../constitution/roadmap.md)).
2. Open the linked brief before implementation.
3. When a feature ships, move its summary into [baseline.md](./baseline.md) and mark the brief **Shipped**.

## Priority backlog

| P | Feature | Phase | Brief | Code touchpoints |
|---|---------|-------|-------|------------------|
| 0 | Weekly personal publish loop | — | [personal-release-cadence.md](./personal-release-cadence.md) | backup, versions, build commands |
| 1 | Content update without reinstall | 8 | [content-updates.md](./content-updates.md) | `src-tauri/src/content/`, CLI TBD |
| 1 | Level 2+ / weekly curriculum edits | 8 | [level-2-curriculum.md](./level-2-curriculum.md) | `content/curriculum/specs/`, validators |
| 2 | Native audio & recording on device | 7 | [native-ios-audio.md](./native-ios-audio.md) | `src/services/audio/`, `LearnerRecordingPanel` |
| 2 | Human / studio phrase audio | 7 | [human-phrase-audio.md](./human-phrase-audio.md) | `content/audio/`, `content:validate`, import |
| 3 | Real AI grammar insights (opt-in) | 9 | [ai-grammar-insights.md](./ai-grammar-insights.md) | `src/services/ai/`, phrase detail |
| 3 | Settings in primary navigation | — | [settings-discoverability.md](./settings-discoverability.md) | `BottomNav`, `HomeScreen` |
| 4 | Phrase search & browse | — | [phrase-search-browse.md](./phrase-search-browse.md) | new feature + IPC list/search |
| 4 | Guided onboarding & goals | — | [guided-onboarding.md](./guided-onboarding.md) | `OnboardingScreen`, learner profile |
| 4 | Unit map & learning path UX | — | [learn-path-ux.md](./learn-path-ux.md) | `LearnScreen`, curriculum metadata |

**P0** = how you install weekly without losing progress. **P1** = content velocity + safe imports. **P2** = practice quality on your phone. **P3–4** = polish when daily use exposes friction.

## Shipped baseline

What already exists in the repo is catalogued in [baseline.md](./baseline.md). Treat it as the feature inventory, not duplicate specs.

## Spec template

New briefs should include:

- **Learner outcome** — one sentence a user would say after using it.
- **Principles** — which items from [mission](../constitution/mission.md) apply.
- **In scope / out of scope** — especially boundaries (no cloud accounts, no invented curriculum).
- **Acceptance criteria** — testable, including offline where relevant.
- **Dependencies** — content version, schema migration, platform.

## Related docs

- [Vision](../vision.md) · [Mission](../constitution/mission.md) · [Roadmap](../constitution/roadmap.md) · [Tech stack](../constitution/techstack.md) · [Architecture](../ARCHITECTURE.md)
````

````markdown
# Settings discoverability

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Status | Planned |
| Roadmap | Cross-cutting UX |
| Priority | P3 |

## Learner outcome

“I can change my daily goal and restore a backup without hunting through the Progress screen.”

## Problem

- `SettingsScreen` exists at `/settings` but is **not** in `BottomNav`.
- Only link: Progress → “Settings” text link.
- Daily goal affects Home streak UX — learners may not find it.

## Principles

- **Local-first** — backup/restore and goals are core trust features, not hidden admin.

## In scope

- One of (pick during implementation):
  - Fifth tab “More” or gear on Home header linking to Settings, **or**
  - Settings entry on Home below daily goal card.
- Safe area and iPad layout check.
- Deep link `/settings` unchanged for bookmarks.

## Out of scope

- Account settings, notifications push, theme marketplace.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] New user can reach Settings within 2 taps from Home.
- [ ] Bottom nav remains thumb-friendly on iPhone SE size.
- [ ] No regression to lesson routes (settings not shown during lesson player).

## Dependencies

- None technical; pure UI routing.
````

## File: scripts/curriculum/assemble.py
````python
"""Assemble beginner-path.json from structured curriculum data."""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any


def audio_for(item_id: str) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    base = f"content/audio/{item_id}"
    return [
        {
            "id": f"audio-{item_id}-normal",
            "learning_item_id": item_id,
            "source": "tts",
            "speaking_speed": "normal",
            "review_status": "approved",
            "duration_ms": 450,
            "file_format": "wav",
            "relative_path": f"{base}-normal.wav",
        },
        {
            "id": f"audio-{item_id}-slow",
            "learning_item_id": item_id,
            "source": "tts",
            "speaking_speed": "slow",
            "review_status": "approved",
            "duration_ms": 650,
            "file_format": "wav",
            "relative_path": f"{base}-slow.wav",
        },
    ]


def lesson_exercises(
    lesson_id: str,
    slug: str,
    core: list[dict[str, Any]],
    convo: dict[str, Any],
    *,
    en_kn_index: int = 1,
    kn_en: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    fill: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    tiles: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    ex: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    order = 1
    ex.append(
        {
            "id": f"ex-{slug}-flash",
            "lesson_id": lesson_id,
            "learning_item_id": core[0]["id"],
            "exercise_type": "vocabulary_flashcard",
            "sort_order": order,
            "prompt": {"instruction": "Learn this phrase."},
        }
    )
    order += 1
    mcq_item = core[1] if len(core) > 1 else core[0]
    distractors = [c["english_meaning"] for c in core[2:5]] if len(core) > 2 else []
    while len(distractors) < 3:
        distractors.append("Thank you")
    choices = [distractors[0], mcq_item["english_meaning"], distractors[1], distractors[2]]
    if choices[1] != mcq_item["english_meaning"]:
        ci = choices.index(mcq_item["english_meaning"])
        choices[1], choices[ci] = choices[ci], choices[1]
    ex.append(
        {
            "id": f"ex-{slug}-mcq",
            "lesson_id": lesson_id,
            "learning_item_id": mcq_item["id"],
            "exercise_type": "listen_identify",
            "sort_order": order,
            "prompt": {
                "instruction": "What does this phrase mean?",
                "choices": choices,
                "correct_index": 1,
            },
        }
    )
    order += 1
    en_item = core[min(en_kn_index, len(core) - 1)]
    ex.append(
        {
            "id": f"ex-{slug}-en-kn",
            "lesson_id": lesson_id,
            "learning_item_id": en_item["id"],
            "exercise_type": "english_to_kannada",
            "sort_order": order,
            "prompt": {"instruction": f"How do you say '{en_item['english_meaning']}' in Kannada?"},
        }
    )
    order += 1
    kn_item = core[min(2, len(core) - 1)]
    kn_prompt = kn_en or {
        "instruction": "Choose the best English meaning.",
        "choices": [core[0]["english_meaning"], kn_item["english_meaning"], core[-1]["english_meaning"], "Good night"],
        "correct_index": 1,
    }
    ex.append(
        {
            "id": f"ex-{slug}-kn-en",
            "lesson_id": lesson_id,
            "learning_item_id": kn_item["id"],
            "exercise_type": "kannada_to_english",
            "sort_order": order,
            "prompt": kn_prompt,
        }
    )
    order += 1
    if fill:
        ex.append(
            {
                "id": f"ex-{slug}-fill",
                "lesson_id": lesson_id,
                "learning_item_id": fill["item_id"],
                "exercise_type": "fill_blank",
                "sort_order": order,
                "prompt": {
                    "instruction": fill["instruction"],
                    "blanked_transliteration": fill["blank"],
                    "accepted": fill["accepted"],
                },
            }
        )
        order += 1
    elif tiles:
        ex.append(
            {
                "id": f"ex-{slug}-order",
                "lesson_id": lesson_id,
                "learning_item_id": tiles["item_id"],
                "exercise_type": "sentence_construction",
                "sort_order": order,
                "prompt": {
                    "instruction": tiles.get("instruction", "Arrange the words (transliteration tiles)."),
                    "tiles": tiles["tiles"],
                    "solution": tiles["solution"],
                },
            }
        )
        order += 1
    ex.append(
        {
            "id": f"ex-{slug}-repeat",
            "lesson_id": lesson_id,
            "learning_item_id": core[-1]["id"],
            "exercise_type": "listen_repeat",
            "sort_order": order,
            "prompt": {"instruction": "Listen and repeat aloud. Mark how you did."},
        }
    )
    order += 1
    ex.append(
        {
            "id": f"ex-{slug}-convo",
            "lesson_id": lesson_id,
            "exercise_type": "scripted_conversation",
            "sort_order": order,
            "prompt": convo,
        }
    )
    return ex


def assemble_bundle(data: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    phrases_by_id: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = data["phrases_by_id"]
    lessons_meta = data["lessons_meta"]
    skip = set(data.get("skip_generated_lessons") or [])
    exercises_hand = data.get("exercises_hand") or []
    convo_specs: dict[str, Any] = data.get("convo_specs") or {}
    fill_specs: dict[str, Any] = data.get("fill_specs") or {}
    tile_specs: dict[str, Any] = data.get("tile_specs") or {}

    generated_exercises: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for lesson in lessons_meta:
        lid = lesson["id"]
        if lid in skip:
            continue
        core = [phrases_by_id[pid] for pid in lesson["phrase_ids"]]
        slug = lid.replace("lesson-", "")
        gen = lesson.get("generated") or {}
        generated_exercises.extend(
            lesson_exercises(
                lid,
                slug,
                core,
                gen.get("convo") or convo_specs[lid],
                en_kn_index=gen.get("en_kn_index", 1),
                kn_en=gen.get("kn_en"),
                fill=gen.get("fill") or fill_specs.get(lid),
                tiles=gen.get("tiles") or tile_specs.get(lid),
            )
        )

    all_items = list(phrases_by_id.values())
    audio: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for it in all_items:
        audio.extend(audio_for(it["id"]))
    for extra in data.get("extra_audio_assets") or []:
        audio.append(extra)

    lesson_items: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    lessons_json: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for lesson in lessons_meta:
        lid = lesson["id"]
        core = [phrases_by_id[pid] for pid in lesson["phrase_ids"]]
        lessons_json.append(
            {
                "id": lid,
                "unit_id": lesson["unit_id"],
                "ordinal": lesson["ordinal"],
                "title": lesson["title"],
                "description": lesson["description"],
                "estimated_minutes": lesson["estimated_minutes"],
            }
        )
        lesson_items.extend(
            [{"lesson_id": lid, "learning_item_id": it["id"], "sort_order": n + 1} for n, it in enumerate(core)]
        )

    if exercises_hand:
        hand = list(exercises_hand)
    else:
        hand = []
        for lesson in lessons_meta:
            if lesson.get("hand_exercises"):
                hand.extend(lesson["hand_exercises"])

    return {
        "content_version": data["content_version"],
        "course": data["course"],
        "levels": data["levels"],
        "units": data["units"],
        "lessons": lessons_json,
        "learning_items": all_items,
        "audio_assets": audio,
        "lesson_items": lesson_items,
        "exercises": hand + generated_exercises,
    }
````

## File: scripts/curriculum/write_level2_units.py
````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Write Level 2 unit spec files (run once when authoring; output is committed)."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
UNITS_DIR = ROOT / "content" / "curriculum" / "specs" / "units"
LEVEL_ID = "level-2-everyday"

Phrase = dict[str, Any]
UnitSpec = dict[str, Any]


def phrase(
    pid: str,
    kn: str,
    tr: str,
    en: str,
    *,
    note: str | None = None,
    register: str = "informal",
    tags: list[str] | None = None,
    difficulty: int = 2,
    accepted: list[str] | None = None,
) -> Phrase:
    row: Phrase = {
        "id": pid,
        "kannada_text": kn,
        "transliteration": tr,
        "english_meaning": en,
        "register": register,
        "tags": tags or ["level2"],
        "difficulty": difficulty,
        "validation_status": "approved",
    }
    if note:
        row["context_note"] = note
    if accepted:
        row["accepted_answers"] = accepted
    return row


def lesson(
    lid: str,
    ordinal: int,
    title: str,
    description: str,
    phrase_ids: list[str],
    convo_instruction: str,
    partner_kn: str,
    partner_tr: str,
    partner_en: str,
    correct_label: str,
    correct_hint: str,
    fill_item: str,
    fill_en: str,
    fill_blank: str,
    fill_accepted: list[str],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "id": lid,
        "ordinal": ordinal,
        "title": title,
        "description": description,
        "estimated_minutes": 14,
        "phrase_ids": phrase_ids,
        "exercise_mode": "generated",
        "convo": {
            "instruction": convo_instruction,
            "steps": [
                {
                    "narration": "Your conversation partner speaks.",
                    "partner": {
                        "kannada": partner_kn,
                        "transliteration": partner_tr,
                        "english": partner_en,
                    },
                },
                {
                    "narration": "Pick the best reply.",
                    "choices": [
                        {"label": correct_label, "hint": correct_hint, "correct": True},
                        {"label": "illa", "hint": "No", "correct": False},
                        {"label": "dhanyavada", "hint": "Thank you", "correct": False},
                    ],
                },
            ],
        },
        "fill": {
            "item_id": fill_item,
            "instruction": fill_en,
            "blank": fill_blank,
            "accepted": fill_accepted,
        },
    }


UNITS: list[UnitSpec] = [
    {
        "id": "unit-l2-01-work-deeper",
        "ordinal": 1,
        "title": "Deeper work chat",
        "description": "Standups, deadlines, and polite pushback at the office.",

    main()
````

````javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
/**
 * Validate bundled curriculum and import into a learner SQLite database.
 * Run `npm run content:build` first if specs changed.
 */
import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
import path from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

const root = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const tauriDir = path.join(root, "src-tauri");

const validate = spawnSync("npm", ["run", "content:validate"], {
  cwd: root,
  stdio: "inherit",
  shell: true,
});
if (validate.status !== 0) {
  process.exit(validate.status ?? 1);
}

const extra = process.argv.slice(2);
const cargo = spawnSync(
  "cargo",
  ["run", "--quiet", "--bin", "content_import", "--", ...extra],
  { cwd: tauriDir, stdio: "inherit", env: process.env },
);
process.exit(cargo.status ?? 1);
````

## File: scripts/ios-xcodegen.sh
````bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Regenerate src-tauri/gen/apple/*.xcodeproj from project.yml with Tauri-safe tweaks.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
YML="${ROOT}/src-tauri/gen/apple/project.yml"

if [[ ! -f "${YML}" ]]; then
  echo "Missing ${YML}; run: npm run ios:init" >&2
  exit 1
fi

# XcodeGen expands ${VAR} from the generating shell. npm/Cursor set FORCE_COLOR=0, which
# gets baked into the "Build Rust Code" script and is parsed as an invalid arch.
perl -pi -e 's/\$\{FORCE_COLOR\}\s+//g' "${YML}"

# Ensure rustup's cargo/rustc win over Homebrew when Xcode runs the build phase.
if ! grep -q '.cargo/bin' "${YML}"; then
  perl -pi -e 's/^(\s*)(npm run -- tauri ios)/$1export PATH="\$HOME\/.cargo\/bin:\$PATH"\n$1$2/' "${YML}"
fi

(cd "${ROOT}/src-tauri/gen/apple" && env -u FORCE_COLOR xcodegen generate)
echo "Regenerated ${ROOT}/src-tauri/gen/apple/kannada-quest.xcodeproj"
````

## File: src/domain/exercises/evaluate.ts
````typescript
export type ExerciseType =
  | "listen_identify"
  | "vocabulary_flashcard"
  | "kannada_to_english"
  | "english_to_kannada"
  | "sentence_construction"
  | "fill_blank"
  | "listen_repeat"
  | "scripted_conversation";

export interface LearningItemRef {
  kannadaText: string;
  transliteration: string;
  englishMeaning: string;
  acceptedAnswers?: string[];
}

export function normalizeFreeText(value: string): string {
  return value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ").toLowerCase();
}

/** Learner-friendly transliteration compare (strip combining marks). */
export function normalizeTransliteration(value: string): string {
  return normalizeFreeText(value)
    .normalize("NFD")
    .replace(/\p{M}+/gu, "");
}

export function evaluateExactOrAlternatives(
  answer: string,
  canonical: string,
  alternatives: string[] = [],
): boolean {
  const normalized = normalizeTransliteration(answer);
  const accepted = new Set(
    [canonical, ...alternatives].map((s) => normalizeTransliteration(s)),
  );
  return accepted.has(normalized);
}

export function evaluateWordOrder(
  submitted: string[],
  solution: string[],
): boolean {
  if (submitted.length !== solution.length) return false;
  return submitted.every(
    (word, i) => normalizeFreeText(word) === normalizeFreeText(solution[i] ?? ""),
  );
}

export function evaluateMultipleChoice(
  selectedIndex: number,
  correctIndex: number,
): boolean {
  return selectedIndex === correctIndex;
}

export function evaluateKannadaRecall(
  answer: string,
  item: LearningItemRef,
): boolean {
  return evaluateExactOrAlternatives(answer, item.transliteration, [
    item.kannadaText,
    ...(item.acceptedAnswers ?? []),
  ]);
}

export function evaluateEnglishMeaning(
  answer: string,
  item: LearningItemRef,
): boolean {
  return evaluateExactOrAlternatives(answer, item.englishMeaning, [
    ...(item.acceptedAnswers ?? []),
  ]);
}
````

````typescript
import type { ExerciseType } from "../exercises/evaluate";

/** XP earned per exercise completion (distinct from mastery). */
export function xpForExercise(
  exerciseType: ExerciseType | string,
  isCorrect: boolean,
): number {
  if (exerciseType === "vocabulary_flashcard") return 6;
  if (exerciseType === "listen_repeat") return isCorrect ? 8 : 5;
  if (exerciseType === "scripted_conversation") return isCorrect ? 12 : 6;
  return isCorrect ? 10 : 4;
}

export function sumXpFromAttempts(
  attempts: { exerciseType: string; isCorrect: boolean }[],
): number {
  return attempts.reduce(
    (total, a) => total + xpForExercise(a.exerciseType, a.isCorrect),
    0,
  );
}
````

## File: src/domain/revision/sm2.ts
````typescript
export type ReviewGrade = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;

export interface Sm2State {
  easeFactor: number;
  intervalDays: number;
  repetitions: number;
}

export interface Sm2ScheduleResult extends Sm2State {
  nextIntervalDays: number;
  masteryStatus: "new" | "learning" | "reviewing" | "mastered";
}

const MIN_EASE = 1.3;

/** SM-2-inspired scheduler (deterministic, UI-agnostic). */
export function scheduleReview(
  state: Sm2State,
  grade: ReviewGrade,
): Sm2ScheduleResult {
  let { easeFactor, intervalDays, repetitions } = state;

  if (grade < 3) {
    repetitions = 0;
    intervalDays = grade === 0 ? 0 : 1;
    easeFactor = Math.max(MIN_EASE, easeFactor - 0.2);
    return {
      easeFactor,
      intervalDays,
      repetitions,
      nextIntervalDays: intervalDays,
      masteryStatus: "learning",
    };
  }

  easeFactor = Math.max(
    MIN_EASE,
    easeFactor + (0.1 - (5 - grade) * (0.08 + (5 - grade) * 0.02)),
  );

  if (repetitions === 0) {
    intervalDays = 1;
  } else if (repetitions === 1) {
    intervalDays = 3;
  } else {
    intervalDays = Math.max(1, Math.round(intervalDays * easeFactor));
  }
  repetitions += 1;

  const masteryStatus =
    repetitions >= 5 && intervalDays >= 14 ? "mastered" : "reviewing";

  return {
    easeFactor,
    intervalDays,
    repetitions,
    nextIntervalDays: intervalDays,
    masteryStatus,
  };
}

export function gradeFromAttempt(options: {
  isCorrect: boolean;
  selfAssessedConfident?: boolean;
  wasDifficult?: boolean;
}): ReviewGrade {
  if (!options.isCorrect) return options.wasDifficult ? 1 : 0;
  if (options.selfAssessedConfident) return 5;
  if (options.wasDifficult) return 3;
  return 4;
}
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import type { LessonSummary, LevelSummary } from "../../services/api/tauri";
import { tauriApi } from "../../services/api/tauri";

export function LearnScreen() {
  const [levels, setLevels] = useState<LevelSummary[]>([]);
  const [selectedLevel, setSelectedLevel] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [lessons, setLessons] = useState<LessonSummary[]>([]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void tauriApi.listLevels().then((lv) => {
      setLevels(lv);
      if (lv[0]) setSelectedLevel(lv[0].id);
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!selectedLevel) return;
    void tauriApi.listLessonsForLevel(selectedLevel).then(setLessons);
  }, [selectedLevel]);

  const level = levels.find((l) => l.id === selectedLevel);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl px-4 pb-28 pt-4">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-stone-900">Learn</h1>
      <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto">
        {levels.map((lv) => (
          <button
            key={lv.id}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setSelectedLevel(lv.id)}
            className={`whitespace-nowrap rounded-full px-4 py-2 text-sm ${
              selectedLevel === lv.id ? "bg-amber-500 text-white" : "bg-stone-100"
            }`}
          >
            {lv.title}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {level ? (
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-stone-600">
          {level.completedLessons}/{level.totalLessons} lessons complete
        </p>
      ) : null}
      <ul className="mt-4 space-y-3 md:grid md:grid-cols-2 md:gap-4 md:space-y-0">
        {lessons.map((lesson) => (
          <li key={lesson.id}>
            <Link
              to={`/lesson/${lesson.id}`}
              className="block rounded-2xl bg-white p-4 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-stone-200"
            >
              <p className="font-semibold text-stone-900">{lesson.title}</p>
              <p className="text-sm text-stone-500">
                ~{lesson.estimatedMinutes} min {lesson.completed ? "· ✓ done" : ""}
              </p>
            </Link>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## File: src/features/onboarding/OnboardingScreen.tsx
````typescript
import { useState } from "react";
import { tauriApi } from "../../services/api/tauri";

interface Props {
  onDone: () => void;
}

export function OnboardingScreen({ onDone }: Props) {
  const [name, setName] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function finish() {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await tauriApi.completeOnboarding(name.trim() || undefined);
      onDone();
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-dvh flex-col justify-center bg-gradient-to-b from-amber-50 to-stone-100 px-6">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold text-stone-900">Kannada Quest</h1>
      <p className="mt-3 text-stone-700">
        Learn practical spoken Bengaluru Kannada in short daily sessions.
      </p>
      <label className="mt-8 block text-sm font-medium text-stone-600">
        Your name (optional)
        <input
          className="mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-stone-300 bg-white px-4 py-3"
          value={name}
          onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
          placeholder="Learner"
        />
      </label>
      <button
        type="button"
        disabled={busy}
        className="mt-6 rounded-xl bg-amber-500 py-3 text-lg font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-60"
        onClick={() => void finish()}
      >
        Start learning
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { MockAIContentProvider } from "./mockProvider";
import type { AIContentProvider } from "./types";
import { UnconfiguredAIProvider } from "./types";

export type AIProviderMode = "mock" | "unconfigured";

const configuredMode: AIProviderMode =
  import.meta.env.VITE_AI_PROVIDER === "unconfigured" ? "unconfigured" : "mock";

let cached: AIContentProvider | null = null;

/** Returns the configured AI boundary for this build (mock by default). */
export function getAIContentProvider(): AIContentProvider {
  if (cached) return cached;
  cached =
    configuredMode === "mock"
      ? new MockAIContentProvider()
      : new UnconfiguredAIProvider();
  return cached;
}
````

````typescript
import type {
  AIContentProvider,
  ExerciseCandidate,
  ExerciseGenerationInput,
  GrammarExplanation,
  GrammarExplanationInput,
  PhraseVariationInput,
  PhraseVariationResult,
} from "./types";

const GRAMMAR_NOTES: Record<string, GrammarExplanation> = {
  "pattern-sari": {
    title: "Using sari (ಸರಿ)",
    explanationEn:
      "ಸರಿ (sari) is a high-frequency affirmative in Kannada — similar to “okay”, “right”, or “that works”. " +
      "It often closes a short exchange when you accept what was said. Tone is friendly and neutral, not formal.",
  },
  default: {
    title: "Kannada phrase pattern",
    explanationEn:
      "Focus on the chunk as a whole first, then break it into syllables. " +
      "Kannada verb endings and postpositions change meaning subtly — reuse this phrase in the same situation until it feels automatic.",
  },
};

/** Local mock provider for dev/desktop builds — no network or API keys. */
export class MockAIContentProvider implements AIContentProvider {
  async generatePhraseVariations(
    _input: PhraseVariationInput,
  ): Promise<PhraseVariationResult> {
    const drafts: PhraseVariationResult["drafts"] = [
      {
        kannadaText: "ಹೌದು, ಸರಿ",
        transliteration: "haudu, sari",
        englishMeaning: "Yes, okay",
        validationStatus: "draft",
      },
      {
        kannadaText: "ಸರಿ, ಮುಂದುವರಿಸೋಣ",
        transliteration: "sari, munduvarisona",
        englishMeaning: "Okay, let's continue",
        validationStatus: "draft",
      },
    ];
    return { drafts };
  }

  async generateExercises(
    input: ExerciseGenerationInput,
  ): Promise<ExerciseCandidate[]> {
    return input.learningItemIds.slice(0, 2).map((id) => ({
      exerciseType: input.exerciseTypes[0] ?? "english_to_kannada",
      prompt: {
        learningItemId: id,
        hint: "Supplementary recall (mock AI)",
      },
    }));
  }

  async explainGrammar(input: GrammarExplanationInput): Promise<GrammarExplanation> {
    return GRAMMAR_NOTES[input.patternId] ?? GRAMMAR_NOTES.default;
  }
}
````

## File: src/services/audio/nativeIosAudioService.ts
````typescript
import { invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import type {
  AudioAssetRef,
  AudioService,
  PlaybackSpeed,
  RecordingResult,
} from "./types";

async function resolveAbsolutePath(relativePath: string): Promise<string> {
  return invoke<string>("resolve_resource_path", { relativePath });
}

function invokeNative<T>(command: string, args: Record<string, unknown> = {}): Promise<T> {
  return invoke<T>(`plugin:native-audio|${command}`, args);
}

export class NativeIosAudioService implements AudioService {
  async play(asset: AudioAssetRef, speed: PlaybackSpeed = "normal"): Promise<void> {
    if (!asset.relativePath) return;
    const filePath = await resolveAbsolutePath(asset.relativePath);
    const effectiveSpeed =
      speed === "slow" && asset.speakingSpeed === "normal" ? "slow" : speed;
    await invokeNative("play_phrase", {
      request: { filePath, speed: effectiveSpeed },
    });
  }

  async pause(): Promise<void> {
    await invokeNative("pause_playback");
  }

  async startRecording(): Promise<void> {
    await invokeNative("start_recording");
  }

  async stopRecording(): Promise<RecordingResult> {
    const result = await invokeNative<{ filePath: string; durationMs: number }>(
      "stop_recording",
    );
    return { filePath: result.filePath, durationMs: result.durationMs };
  }

  async playLearnerRecording(filePath: string): Promise<void> {
    await invokeNative("play_learner_recording", {
      request: { filePath },
    });
  }
}
````

## File: src-tauri/src/bin/content_import.rs
````rust
//! Import bundled curriculum into a learner SQLite file (power-user / editorial loop).
use std::env;
use std::fs;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::ExitCode;

use tauri_app_lib::content::import::{
    bundle_content_version, import_bundle, import_if_newer, installed_content_version,
    ContentImportOutcome,
};
use tauri_app_lib::db::DbState;

const USAGE: &str = "Usage: content_import [--db PATH] [--bundle PATH] [--force]\n\
Default bundle: content/curriculum/beginner-path.json (relative to repo root).\n\
Default db: $KANNADA_LEARNER_DB or ./learner.sqlite";

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let args: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
    let mut db_path: Option<PathBuf> = env::var("KANNADA_LEARNER_DB").ok().map(PathBuf::from);
    let mut bundle_path: Option<PathBuf> = None;
    let mut force = false;

    let mut i = 1;
    while i < args.len() {
        match args[i].as_str() {
            "--db" => {
                i += 1;
                db_path = Some(PathBuf::from(args.get(i).unwrap_or(&String::new())));
            }
            "--bundle" => {
                i += 1;
                bundle_path = Some(PathBuf::from(args.get(i).unwrap_or(&String::new())));
            }
            "--force" => force = true,
            "-h" | "--help" => {
                eprintln!("{USAGE}");
                return ExitCode::SUCCESS;
            }
            other => {
                eprintln!("Unknown argument: {other}\n{USAGE}");
                return ExitCode::from(2);
            }
        }
        i += 1;
    }

    let db_path = db_path.unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("learner.sqlite"));
    let bundle_path = bundle_path.unwrap_or_else(|| {
        PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
            .join("../content/curriculum/beginner-path.json")
    });

    let json = match fs::read_to_string(&bundle_path) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("Could not read bundle {}: {e}", bundle_path.display());
            return ExitCode::from(1);
        }
    };

    let incoming = bundle_content_version(&json);
    let state = match DbState::open(&db_path) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("Could not open database {}: {e}", db_path.display());
            return ExitCode::from(1);
        }
    };

    let conn = state.conn.lock().expect("db lock");
    let stored = installed_content_version(&conn);

    if force && incoming <= stored {
        match import_bundle(&conn, &json) {
            Ok(items) => {
                println!(
                    "Forced import v{incoming} into {} ({items} items; was v{stored}).",
                    db_path.display()
                );
                return ExitCode::SUCCESS;
            }
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("Import failed: {e}");
                return ExitCode::from(1);
            }
        }
    }

    match import_if_newer(&conn, &json) {
        Ok(ContentImportOutcome::Imported { items, content_version }) => {
            println!(
                "Imported content v{content_version} into {} ({items} learning items).",
                db_path.display()
            );
            ExitCode::SUCCESS
        }
        Ok(ContentImportOutcome::NoChange {
            stored_version,
            incoming_version,
        }) => {
            println!(
                "No import: installed v{stored_version}, bundle v{incoming_version} (use --force to re-apply)."
            );
            ExitCode::SUCCESS
        }
        Err(e) => {
            eprintln!("Import failed: {e}");
            ExitCode::from(1)
        }
    }
}
````

````rust
use crate::db::DbState;
use serde::Serialize;
use tauri::{AppHandle, Manager, State};
use tauri::path::BaseDirectory;

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct AudioAssetDto {
    pub id: String,
    pub learning_item_id: String,
    pub source: String,
    pub speaking_speed: String,
    pub relative_path: Option<String>,
    pub duration_ms: Option<i32>,
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn list_audio_assets(
    state: State<DbState>,
    learning_item_id: String,
) -> Result<Vec<AudioAssetDto>, String> {
    crate::db::with_conn(&state, |conn| {
        let mut stmt = conn
            .prepare(
                "SELECT id, learning_item_id, source, speaking_speed, relative_path, duration_ms
                 FROM audio_assets
                 WHERE learning_item_id = ?1 AND review_status = 'approved'
                 ORDER BY CASE speaking_speed WHEN 'normal' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, source",
            )
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let rows = stmt
            .query_map([&learning_item_id], |row| {
                Ok(AudioAssetDto {
                    id: row.get(0)?,
                    learning_item_id: row.get(1)?,
                    source: row.get(2)?,
                    speaking_speed: row.get(3)?,
                    relative_path: row.get(4)?,
                    duration_ms: row.get(5)?,
                })
            })
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        Ok(rows)
    })
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn resolve_resource_path(app: AppHandle, relative_path: String) -> Result<String, String> {
    app.path()
        .resolve(relative_path, BaseDirectory::Resource)
        .map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn write_learner_recording(
    app: AppHandle,
    bytes: Vec<u8>,
) -> Result<LearnerRecordingMeta, String> {
    let dir = app
        .path()
        .app_data_dir()
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
        .join("learner_recordings");
    std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let id = uuid::Uuid::new_v4().to_string();
    let file_name = format!("{id}.webm");
    let path = dir.join(&file_name);
    std::fs::write(&path, &bytes).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    let duration_ms = rough_webm_duration_ms(&bytes);
    Ok(LearnerRecordingMeta {
        file_path: path.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        duration_ms,
    })
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct LearnerRecordingMeta {
    pub file_path: String,
    pub duration_ms: i64,
}

fn rough_webm_duration_ms(bytes: &[u8]) -> i64 {
    // MVP: estimate from size — replaced when native recording reports duration.
    let kb = bytes.len() as f64 / 1024.0;
    ((kb / 16.0) * 1000.0).clamp(200.0, 120_000.0) as i64
}
````

## File: tauri-plugin-native-audio/ios/Sources/NativeAudioPlugin.swift
````swift
import AVFoundation
import Foundation
import Tauri

private enum AudioError: Error {
  case message(String)

  var message: String {
    switch self {
    case .message(let msg):
      return msg
    }
  }
}

private struct PlayPhraseArgs: Decodable {
  let filePath: String
  let speed: String?
}

private struct PlayLearnerArgs: Decodable {
  let filePath: String
}

private struct RecordingResultPayload: Encodable {
  let filePath: String
  let durationMs: Int
}

class NativeAudioPlugin: Plugin {
  private var phrasePlayer: AVAudioPlayer?
  private var learnerPlayer: AVAudioPlayer?
  private var recorder: AVAudioRecorder?
  private var recordingStartedAt: Date?

  private func activatePlaybackSession() throws {
    let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()
    try session.setCategory(.playback, mode: .spokenAudio, options: [.duckOthers])
    try session.setActive(true)
  }

  private func activateRecordingSession() throws {
    let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()
    try session.setCategory(
      .playAndRecord,
      mode: .spokenAudio,
      options: [.defaultToSpeaker, .allowBluetooth],
    )
    try session.setActive(true)
  }

  private func micDeniedMessage() -> String {
    "Microphone access is off. Open Settings → Kannada Quest and turn on Microphone, then try again."
  }

  private func ensureMicPermission(_ completion: @escaping (Result<Void, AudioError>) -> Void) {
    let session = AVAudioSession.sharedInstance()
    switch session.recordPermission {
    case .granted:
      completion(.success(()))
    case .denied:
      completion(.failure(.message(self.micDeniedMessage())))
    case .undetermined:
      session.requestRecordPermission { granted in
        DispatchQueue.main.async {
          if granted {
            completion(.success(()))
          } else {
            completion(.failure(.message(self.micDeniedMessage())))
          }
        }
      }
    @unknown default:
      completion(.failure(.message(self.micDeniedMessage())))
    }
  }

  @objc public func playPhrase(_ invoke: Invoke) throws {
    let args = try invoke.parseArgs(PlayPhraseArgs.self)
    let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: args.filePath)
    guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else {
      invoke.reject("Audio file is missing. Rebuild and reinstall the app.")
      return
    }
    try activatePlaybackSession()
    phrasePlayer?.stop()
    learnerPlayer?.stop()
    let player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: url)
    player.enableRate = true
    let speed = args.speed ?? "normal"
    player.rate = speed == "slow" ? 0.82 : 1.0
    player.prepareToPlay()
    phrasePlayer = player
    if !player.play() {
      invoke.reject("Could not start playback.")
      return
    }
    invoke.resolve()
  }

  @objc public func pausePlayback(_ invoke: Invoke) throws {
    phrasePlayer?.stop()
    phrasePlayer = nil
    learnerPlayer?.stop()
    learnerPlayer = nil
    invoke.resolve()
  }

  @objc public func startRecording(_ invoke: Invoke) throws {
    ensureMicPermission { result in
      switch result {
      case .failure(let error):
        invoke.reject(error.message)
      case .success:
        do {
          try self.activateRecordingSession()
          let dir = try self.learnerRecordingDirectory()
          let fileName = "\(UUID().uuidString).m4a"
          let fileURL = dir.appendingPathComponent(fileName)
          let settings: [String: Any] = [
            AVFormatIDKey: Int(kAudioFormatMPEG4AAC),
            AVSampleRateKey: 44_100,
            AVNumberOfChannelsKey: 1,
            AVEncoderAudioQualityKey: AVAudioQuality.high.rawValue,
          ]
          let recorder = try AVAudioRecorder(url: fileURL, settings: settings)
          recorder.prepareToRecord()
          self.recordingStartedAt = Date()
          self.recorder = recorder
          if !recorder.record() {
            invoke.reject("Could not start recording.")
            return
          }
          invoke.resolve()
        } catch {
          invoke.reject("Could not start recording: \(error.localizedDescription)")
        }
      }
    }
  }

  @objc public func stopRecording(_ invoke: Invoke) throws {
    guard let recorder = recorder else {
      invoke.reject("No recording in progress.")
      return
    }
    let startedAt = recordingStartedAt ?? Date()
    recorder.stop()
    self.recorder = nil
    recordingStartedAt = nil
    let durationMs = Int(Date().timeIntervalSince(startedAt) * 1000)
    let payload = RecordingResultPayload(
      filePath: recorder.url.path,
      durationMs: max(durationMs, 0),
    )
    invoke.resolve(payload)
  }

  @objc public func playLearnerRecording(_ invoke: Invoke) throws {
    let args = try invoke.parseArgs(PlayLearnerArgs.self)
    let url = URL(fileURLWithPath: args.filePath)
    guard FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath: url.path) else {
      invoke.reject("Recording file is missing.")
      return
    }
    try activatePlaybackSession()
    phrasePlayer?.stop()
    learnerPlayer?.stop()
    let player = try AVAudioPlayer(contentsOf: url)
    player.prepareToPlay()
    learnerPlayer = player
    if !player.play() {
      invoke.reject("Could not play your recording.")
      return
    }
    invoke.resolve()
  }

  private func learnerRecordingDirectory() throws -> URL {
    let docs = try FileManager.default.url(
      for: .documentDirectory,
      in: .userDomainMask,
      appropriateFor: nil,
      create: true,
    )
    let dir = docs.appendingPathComponent("learner_recordings", isDirectory: true)
    try FileManager.default.createDirectory(at: dir, withIntermediateDirectories: true)
    return dir
  }
}

@_cdecl("init_plugin_native_audio")
public func initPlugin() -> Plugin {
  return NativeAudioPlugin()
}
````

````rust
use tauri::{command, AppHandle, Runtime};

use crate::models::*;
use crate::NativeAudioExt;
use crate::Result;

#[command]
pub(crate) async fn play_phrase<R: Runtime>(
  app: AppHandle<R>,
  request: PlayPhraseRequest,
) -> Result<()> {
  app.native_audio().play_phrase(request)
}

#[command]
pub(crate) async fn pause_playback<R: Runtime>(app: AppHandle<R>) -> Result<()> {
  app.native_audio().pause_playback()
}

#[command]
pub(crate) async fn start_recording<R: Runtime>(app: AppHandle<R>) -> Result<()> {
  app.native_audio().start_recording()
}

#[command]
pub(crate) async fn stop_recording<R: Runtime>(app: AppHandle<R>) -> Result<RecordingResult> {
  app.native_audio().stop_recording()
}

#[command]
pub(crate) async fn play_learner_recording<R: Runtime>(
  app: AppHandle<R>,
  request: PlayLearnerRecordingRequest,
) -> Result<()> {
  app.native_audio().play_learner_recording(request)
}
````

## File: tauri-plugin-native-audio/src/error.rs
````rust
use serde::{ser::Serializer, Serialize};

pub type Result<T> = std::result::Result<T, Error>;

#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
pub enum Error {
  #[error(transparent)]
  Io(#[from] std::io::Error),
  #[error("Native iOS audio is only available on device builds.")]
  UnsupportedPlatform,
  #[cfg(mobile)]
  #[error(transparent)]
  PluginInvoke(#[from] tauri::plugin::mobile::PluginInvokeError),
}

impl Serialize for Error {
  fn serialize<S>(&self, serializer: S) -> std::result::Result<S::Ok, S::Error>
  where
    S: Serializer,
  {
    serializer.serialize_str(self.to_string().as_ref())
  }
}
````

## File: tauri-plugin-native-audio/src/lib.rs
````rust
use tauri::{
  plugin::{Builder, TauriPlugin},
  Manager, Runtime,
};

pub use models::*;

#[cfg(desktop)]
mod desktop;
#[cfg(mobile)]
mod mobile;

mod commands;
mod error;
mod models;

pub use error::{Error, Result};

#[cfg(desktop)]
use desktop::NativeAudio;
#[cfg(mobile)]
use mobile::NativeAudio;

/// Extensions to [`tauri::App`], [`tauri::AppHandle`] and [`tauri::Window`] to access the native-audio APIs.
pub trait NativeAudioExt<R: Runtime> {
  fn native_audio(&self) -> &NativeAudio<R>;
}

impl<R: Runtime, T: Manager<R>> crate::NativeAudioExt<R> for T {
  fn native_audio(&self) -> &NativeAudio<R> {
    self.state::<NativeAudio<R>>().inner()
  }
}

/// Initializes the plugin.
pub fn init<R: Runtime>() -> TauriPlugin<R> {
  Builder::new("native-audio")
    .invoke_handler(tauri::generate_handler![
      commands::play_phrase,
      commands::pause_playback,
      commands::start_recording,
      commands::stop_recording,
      commands::play_learner_recording,
    ])
    .setup(|app, api| {
      #[cfg(mobile)]
      let native_audio = mobile::init(app, api)?;
      #[cfg(desktop)]
      let native_audio = desktop::init(app, api)?;
      app.manage(native_audio);
      Ok(())
    })
    .build()
}
````

````rust
use serde::de::DeserializeOwned;
use tauri::{
  plugin::{PluginApi, PluginHandle},
  AppHandle, Runtime,
};

use crate::models::*;

#[cfg(target_os = "ios")]
tauri::ios_plugin_binding!(init_plugin_native_audio);

pub fn init<R: Runtime, C: DeserializeOwned>(
  _app: &AppHandle<R>,
  api: PluginApi<R, C>,
) -> crate::Result<NativeAudio<R>> {
  #[cfg(target_os = "android")]
  let handle = api.register_android_plugin("", "NativeAudioPlugin")?;
  #[cfg(target_os = "ios")]
  let handle = api.register_ios_plugin(init_plugin_native_audio)?;
  Ok(NativeAudio(handle))
}

/// Access to the native-audio APIs.
pub struct NativeAudio<R: Runtime>(PluginHandle<R>);

impl<R: Runtime> NativeAudio<R> {
  pub fn play_phrase(&self, request: PlayPhraseRequest) -> crate::Result<()> {
    self
      .0
      .run_mobile_plugin("playPhrase", request)
      .map_err(Into::into)
  }

  pub fn pause_playback(&self) -> crate::Result<()> {
    self
      .0
      .run_mobile_plugin("pausePlayback", ())
      .map_err(Into::into)
  }

  pub fn start_recording(&self) -> crate::Result<()> {
    self
      .0
      .run_mobile_plugin("startRecording", ())
      .map_err(Into::into)
  }

  pub fn stop_recording(&self) -> crate::Result<RecordingResult> {
    self
      .0
      .run_mobile_plugin("stopRecording", ())
      .map_err(Into::into)
  }

  pub fn play_learner_recording(
    &self,
    request: PlayLearnerRecordingRequest,
  ) -> crate::Result<()> {
    self
      .0
      .run_mobile_plugin("playLearnerRecording", request)
      .map_err(Into::into)
  }
}
````

````typescript
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { gradeFromAttempt, scheduleReview } from "../../src/domain/revision/sm2";

describe("scheduleReview", () => {
  it("resets on failure", () => {
    const next = scheduleReview(
      { easeFactor: 2.5, intervalDays: 10, repetitions: 4 },
      0,
    );
    expect(next.repetitions).toBe(0);
    expect(next.intervalDays).toBe(0);
    expect(next.masteryStatus).toBe("learning");
  });

  it("grows interval on success", () => {
    const first = scheduleReview(
      { easeFactor: 2.5, intervalDays: 0, repetitions: 0 },
      4,
    );
    expect(first.intervalDays).toBe(1);
    const second = scheduleReview(first, 4);
    expect(second.intervalDays).toBe(3);
    const third = scheduleReview(second, 5);
    expect(third.intervalDays).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(7);
  });
});

  it("maps self-assessed speaking", () => {
    expect(gradeFromAttempt({ isCorrect: true, selfAssessedConfident: true })).toBe(5);

  });
});
````

````typescript
import tailwindcss from "@tailwindcss/vite";
import { defineConfig } from "vite";
import react from "@vitejs/plugin-react";
// @ts-expect-error type error without @types/node package
import process from "node:process";
const host = process.env.TAURI_DEV_HOST;

// https://vite.dev/config/
export default defineConfig(() => ({
  plugins: [react(), tailwindcss()],
  test: {
    environment: "node",
    include: ["tests/unit/**/*.test.ts"],
  },

  // Vite options tailored for Tauri development and only applied in `tauri dev` or `tauri build`
  //
  // 1. prevent Vite from obscuring rust errors
  clearScreen: false,
  // 2. tauri expects a fixed port, fail if that port is not available
  server: {
    port: 1420,
    strictPort: true,
    host: host || false,
    hmr: host
      ? {
          protocol: "ws",
          host,
          port: 1421,
        }
      : undefined,
    watch: {
      // 3. tell Vite to ignore watching `src-tauri`
      ignored: ["**/src-tauri/**"],
    },
  },
}));
````
