````typescript
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type { ExerciseDto, LearningItemDto } from "../../services/api/tauri";
import {
  evaluateKannadaRecall,
  evaluateMultipleChoice,
  evaluateWordOrder,
  normalizeFreeText,
} from "../../domain/exercises/evaluate";
import { ExerciseContinueBar } from "./ExerciseContinueBar";
import { LearnerRecordingPanel } from "../audio/LearnerRecordingPanel";
import { PhraseAudioControls } from "../audio/PhraseAudioControls";

export interface ExerciseResult {
  isCorrect: boolean;
  response: Record<string, unknown>;
  selfAssessed?: boolean;
}

interface Props {
  exercise: ExerciseDto;
  onComplete: (result: ExerciseResult) => void;
}

interface ConversationChoice {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  correct: boolean;
}

interface ConversationStep {
  narration?: string;
  partner?: {
    kannada: string;
    transliteration: string;
    english: string;
  };
  choices?: ConversationChoice[];
  explanation?: string;
}

function PhraseCard({
  item,
  showText = true,
  showAudio = false,
}: {
  item: LearningItemDto;
  showText?: boolean;
  showAudio?: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 shadow-sm ring-1 ring-stone-200 space-y-3">
      {showText ? (
        <>
          <p className="text-3xl font-semibold text-stone-900 kannada">{item.kannadaText}</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-lg text-amber-800">{item.transliteration}</p>
        </>
      ) : (
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-stone-500">Listen carefully before you answer.</p>
      )}
      {showAudio ? (
        <PhraseAudioControls
          learningItemId={item.id}
          compact={!showText}
          autoPlay={!showText}
        />
      ) : null}
      {item.contextNote && showText ? (
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-stone-600">{item.contextNote}</p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

export function ExerciseRenderer({ exercise, onComplete }: Props) {
  const item = exercise.learningItem;
  const [revealed, setRevealed] = useState(false);
  const [textAnswer, setTextAnswer] = useState("");
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [tiles, setTiles] = useState<string[]>(
    () => (exercise.prompt.tiles as string[] | undefined)?.slice() ?? [],
  );
  const [built, setBuilt] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<{
    result: ExerciseResult;
    message: string;
    explanation?: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const choices = useMemo(
    () => (exercise.prompt.choices as string[] | undefined) ?? [],
    [exercise.prompt.choices],
  );

  function queueResult(
    result: ExerciseResult,
    message: string,
    explanation?: string,
  ) {
    setPending({ result, message, explanation });
  }

  function submitMcq(correctIndex: number) {
    if (selected === null) return;
    const isCorrect = evaluateMultipleChoice(selected, correctIndex);
    queueResult(
      { isCorrect, response: { selected } },
      isCorrect ? "Correct" : "Not quite — check the meaning again.",
      isCorrect ? undefined : "Review the phrase card before you continue.",
    );
  }

  if (!item && exercise.exerciseType !== "vocabulary_flashcard" && exercise.exerciseType !== "scripted_conversation") {
    return <p className="text-stone-600">Exercise is missing phrase data.</p>;
  }

  const instruction = String(exercise.prompt.instruction ?? "Complete the exercise.");

  const continueBar = pending ? (
    <ExerciseContinueBar
      feedback={pending.message}
      isCorrect={pending.result.isCorrect}
      explanation={pending.explanation}
      onContinue={() => onComplete(pending.result)}
    />
  ) : null;

  switch (exercise.exerciseType) {
    case "vocabulary_flashcard":
      if (!item) return null;
      return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-stone-700">{instruction}</p>
          <PhraseCard item={item} showAudio />
          {!revealed ? (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="w-full rounded-xl bg-amber-500 py-3 font-semibold text-white"
              onClick={() => setRevealed(true)}
            >
              Reveal meaning
            </button>
          ) : (
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <p className="text-xl font-medium text-stone-900">{item.englishMeaning}</p>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="w-full rounded-xl bg-stone-900 py-3 font-semibold text-white"
                onClick={() =>
                  onComplete({ isCorrect: true, response: { revealed: true } })
                }
              >
                Continue
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      );

    case "listen_identify":
      if (!item) return null;
      return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-stone-700">{instruction}</p>
          <PhraseCard item={item} showText={false} showAudio />
          <div className="grid gap-2">
            {choices.map((choice, index) => (
              <button
                key={choice}
                type="button"
                disabled={!!pending}
                className={`rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-left ${
                  selected === index ? "border-amber-500 bg-amber-50" : "border-stone-200"
                }`}
                onClick={() => setSelected(index)}
              >
                {choice}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="w-full rounded-xl bg-amber-500 py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50"
            disabled={selected === null || !!pending}
            onClick={() =>
              submitMcq(Number(exercise.prompt.correct_index ?? exercise.prompt.correctIndex))
            }
          >
            Check
          </button>
          {continueBar}
        </div>
      );

    case "kannada_to_english":
      if (!item) return null;
      return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-stone-700">{instruction}</p>
          <PhraseCard item={item} showAudio />
          <div className="grid gap-2">
            {choices.map((choice, index) => (
              <button
                key={choice}
                type="button"
                disabled={!!pending}
                className={`rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-left ${
                  selected === index ? "border-amber-500 bg-amber-50" : "border-stone-200"
                }`}
                onClick={() => setSelected(index)}
              >
                {choice}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="w-full rounded-xl bg-amber-500 py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50"
            disabled={selected === null || !!pending}
            onClick={() =>
              submitMcq(Number(exercise.prompt.correct_index ?? exercise.prompt.correctIndex))
            }
          >
            Check
          </button>
          {continueBar}
        </div>
      );

    case "english_to_kannada":
      if (!item) return null;
      return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-stone-700">{instruction}</p>
          <p className="text-xl font-medium">{item.englishMeaning}</p>
          <input
            className="w-full rounded-xl border border-stone-300 px-4 py-3 text-lg"
            value={textAnswer}
            onChange={(e) => setTextAnswer(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Type Kannada or transliteration"
            autoCapitalize="off"
            autoCorrect="off"
            disabled={!!pending}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="w-full rounded-xl bg-amber-500 py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50"
            disabled={!!pending}
            onClick={() => {
              const isCorrect = evaluateKannadaRecall(textAnswer, {
                kannadaText: item.kannadaText,
                transliteration: item.transliteration,
                englishMeaning: item.englishMeaning,
                acceptedAnswers: item.acceptedAnswers,
              });
              queueResult(
                { isCorrect, response: { textAnswer } },
                isCorrect ? "Correct" : "Keep practising this one.",
                isCorrect
                  ? undefined
                  : `Expected something like “${item.transliteration}”.`,
              );
            }}
          >
            Check
          </button>
          {continueBar}
        </div>
      );

    case "fill_blank": {
      if (!item) return null;
      const accepted =
        (exercise.prompt.accepted as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
      const blanked = String(exercise.prompt.blanked_transliteration ?? "");
      return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-stone-700">{instruction}</p>
          <p className="text-lg text-stone-800">{blanked}</p>
          <input
            className="w-full rounded-xl border border-stone-300 px-4 py-3"
            value={textAnswer}
            onChange={(e) => setTextAnswer(e.target.value)}
            disabled={!!pending}
          />
          <button
            type="button"
            className="w-full rounded-xl bg-amber-500 py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50"
            disabled={!!pending}
            onClick={() => {
              const isCorrect = [item.transliteration, ...accepted].some(
                (v) => normalizeFreeText(textAnswer) === normalizeFreeText(v),
              );
              queueResult(
                { isCorrect, response: { textAnswer } },
                isCorrect ? "Correct" : "That blank needs another try.",
              );
            }}
          >
            Check
          </button>
          {continueBar}
        </div>
      );
    }

    case "sentence_construction": {
      const solution =
        (exercise.prompt.solution as string[] | undefined) ?? [];
      return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-stone-700">{instruction}</p>
          <div className="min-h-12 rounded-xl border border-dashed border-stone-300 p-3">
            {built.length === 0 ? (
              <span className="text-stone-400">Tap words in order</span>
            ) : (
              built.join(" ")
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            {tiles.map((tile) => (
              <button
                key={tile}
                type="button"
                disabled={!!pending}
                className="rounded-full bg-stone-100 px-4 py-2 text-sm"
                onClick={() => {
                  setBuilt((prev) => [...prev, tile]);
                  setTiles((prev) => prev.filter((t) => t !== tile));
                }}
              >
                {tile}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            className="w-full rounded-xl bg-amber-500 py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50"
            disabled={!!pending || built.length === 0}
            onClick={() => {
              const isCorrect = evaluateWordOrder(built, solution);
              queueResult(
                { isCorrect, response: { built } },
                isCorrect ? "Correct order" : "Word order is not quite right.",
                isCorrect ? undefined : `Solution: ${solution.join(" ")}`,
              );
            }}
          >
            Check order
          </button>
          {continueBar}
        </div>
      );
    }

    case "listen_repeat":
      if (!item) return null;
      return (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <p className="text-stone-700">{instruction}</p>
          <PhraseCard item={item} showAudio />
          <LearnerRecordingPanel />
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
            {[
              { label: "Needs practice", ok: false, confident: false },
              { label: "Good", ok: true, confident: false },
              { label: "Easy", ok: true, confident: true },
            ].map((opt) => (
              <button
                key={opt.label}
                type="button"
                className="rounded-xl border border-stone-200 py-3 text-sm"
                onClick={() =>
                  onComplete({
                    isCorrect: opt.ok,
                    selfAssessed: opt.confident,
                    response: { selfGrade: opt.label },
                  })
                }
              >
                {opt.label}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      );

    case "scripted_conversation":
      return (
        <ScriptedConversation
          instruction={instruction}
          steps={(exercise.prompt.steps as ConversationStep[] | undefined) ?? []}
          onComplete={onComplete}
        />
      );

    default:
      return (
        <p className="text-stone-600">Unsupported exercise type: {exercise.exerciseType}</p>
      );
  }
}

function ScriptedConversation({
  instruction,
  steps,
  onComplete,
}: {
  instruction: string;
  steps: ConversationStep[];
  onComplete: (result: ExerciseResult) => void;
}) {
  const [stepIndex, setStepIndex] = useState(0);
  const [wrongChoice, setWrongChoice] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hadWrong, setHadWrong] = useState(false);

  const step = steps[stepIndex];
  if (!step) {
    return <p className="text-stone-600">Conversation has no steps.</p>;
  }

  function advance() {
    setWrongChoice(null);
    if (stepIndex + 1 >= steps.length) {
      onComplete({
        isCorrect: !hadWrong,
        response: { stepsCompleted: steps.length, hadWrong },
      });
      return;
    }
    setStepIndex((i) => i + 1);
  }

  if (step.partner) {
    return (
      <div className="space-y-4">
        <p className="text-stone-700">{instruction}</p>
        {step.narration ? (
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-stone-500">{step.narration}</p>
        ) : null}
        <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 ring-1 ring-stone-200">
          <p className="text-sm text-stone-500">Partner</p>
          <p className="text-3xl font-semibold kannada">{step.partner.kannada}</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-lg text-amber-800">{step.partner.transliteration}</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-stone-700">{step.partner.english}</p>
        </div>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="w-full rounded-xl bg-stone-900 py-3 font-semibold text-white"
          onClick={advance}
        >
          Continue
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const choiceStep = step;
  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <p className="text-stone-700">{instruction}</p>
      {choiceStep.narration ? (
        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-stone-500">{choiceStep.narration}</p>
      ) : null}
      <div className="grid gap-2">
        {(choiceStep.choices ?? []).map((choice) => (
          <button
            key={choice.label}
            type="button"
            className={`rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 text-left ${
              wrongChoice === choice.label
                ? "border-red-300 bg-red-50"
                : "border-stone-200"
            }`}
            onClick={() => {
              if (choice.correct) {
                advance();
              } else {
                setHadWrong(true);
                setWrongChoice(choice.label);
              }
            }}
          >
            <span className="font-medium">{choice.label}</span>
            {choice.hint ? (
              <span className="mt-1 block text-sm text-stone-500">{choice.hint}</span>
            ) : null}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {wrongChoice && choiceStep.explanation ? (
        <p className="rounded-xl bg-amber-50 p-3 text-sm text-stone-700">
          {choiceStep.explanation}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link, useParams } from "react-router-dom";
import type { LearningItemDetail } from "../../services/api/tauri";
import { PhraseAudioControls } from "../../components/audio/PhraseAudioControls";
import { getAIContentProvider } from "../../services/ai";
import type { GrammarExplanation } from "../../services/ai";
import { tauriApi } from "../../services/api/tauri";

function grammarPatternForItem(itemId: string): string {
  if (itemId.includes("sari")) return "pattern-sari";
  return "default";
}

export function PhraseDetailScreen() {
  const { itemId = "" } = useParams();
  const [detail, setDetail] = useState<LearningItemDetail | null>(null);
  const [grammar, setGrammar] = useState<GrammarExplanation | null>(null);
  const [grammarLoading, setGrammarLoading] = useState(false);
  const [grammarError, setGrammarError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!itemId) return;
    void tauriApi.getLearningItemDetail(itemId).then(setDetail);
  }, [itemId]);

  async function loadGrammarExplanation() {
    if (!itemId) return;
    setGrammarLoading(true);
    setGrammarError(null);
    try {
      const provider = getAIContentProvider();
      const explanation = await provider.explainGrammar({
        patternId: grammarPatternForItem(itemId),
        exampleItemIds: [itemId],
      });
      setGrammar(explanation);
    } catch (err) {
      setGrammarError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Could not load explanation.");
    } finally {
      setGrammarLoading(false);
    }
  }

  if (!detail) {
    return <p className="p-6 text-stone-600">Loading phrase…</p>;
  }

  const mastery = detail.progress?.masteryStatus ?? "new";

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl px-4 pb-28 pt-4">
      <Link to="/progress" className="text-sm text-amber-800">
        ← Progress
      </Link>
      <div className="mt-4 rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 ring-1 ring-stone-200">
        <p className="text-4xl font-semibold kannada">{detail.kannadaText}</p>
        <p className="mt-2 text-xl text-amber-800">{detail.transliteration}</p>
        <p className="mt-3 text-lg text-stone-900">{detail.englishMeaning}</p>
        {detail.literalTranslation ? (
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-stone-500">
            Literal: {detail.literalTranslation}
          </p>
        ) : null}
        {detail.contextNote ? (
          <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-stone-600">{detail.contextNote}</p>
        ) : null}
        <PhraseAudioControls learningItemId={detail.id} className="mt-4" />
      </div>

      <section className="mt-6 grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-3">
        <Stat label="Mastery" value={mastery} />
        <Stat label="Attempts" value={detail.attemptCount} />
        <Stat
          label="Accuracy"
          value={
            detail.attemptCount > 0
              ? `${Math.round((detail.correctCount / detail.attemptCount) * 100)}%`
              : "—"
          }
        />
      </section>

      {detail.progress || detail.nextReviewAt ? (
        <section className="mt-6 rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 ring-1 ring-stone-200">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-stone-900">Review schedule</h2>
          <dl className="mt-3 grid gap-2 text-sm md:grid-cols-3">
            {detail.progress ? (
              <>
                <ScheduleRow label="Interval" value={`${detail.progress.intervalDays} days`} />
                <ScheduleRow label="Ease" value={detail.progress.easeFactor.toFixed(2)} />
              </>
            ) : null}
            <ScheduleRow
              label="Next review"
              value={
                detail.nextReviewAt
                  ? new Date(detail.nextReviewAt).toLocaleString()
                  : "Not scheduled"
              }
            />
          </dl>
        </section>
      ) : null}

      <section className="mt-6 rounded-2xl bg-amber-50 p-5 ring-1 ring-amber-200">
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-stone-900">Grammar insight (AI)</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-stone-600">
          Supplementary notes — mock provider in dev; no data leaves your device in this build.
        </p>
        {grammar ? (
          <div className="mt-3 text-sm text-stone-800">
            <p className="font-medium">{grammar.title}</p>
            <p className="mt-2">{grammar.explanationEn}</p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <button
            type="button"
            className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-stone-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white disabled:opacity-50"
            disabled={grammarLoading}
            onClick={() => void loadGrammarExplanation()}
          >
            {grammarLoading ? "Loading…" : "Explain this phrase"}
          </button>
        )}
        {grammarError ? <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-red-700">{grammarError}</p> : null}
      </section>

      {detail.recentAttempts.length > 0 ? (
        <section className="mt-6">
          <h2 className="font-semibold text-stone-900">Recent attempts</h2>
          <ul className="mt-3 space-y-2">
            {detail.recentAttempts.map((row, i) => (
              <li
                key={`${row.attemptedAt}-${i}`}
                className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm ring-1 ring-stone-200"
              >
                <span className="text-stone-700">{row.exerciseType.replace(/_/g, " ")}</span>
                <span className={row.isCorrect ? "text-emerald-700" : "text-amber-800"}>
                  {row.isCorrect ? "Correct" : "Needs work"}
                </span>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      ) : (
        <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-stone-500">
          Complete a lesson or practice item to build history for this phrase.
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function Stat({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | number }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-4 ring-1 ring-stone-200">
      <p className="text-sm text-stone-500">{label}</p>
      <p className="text-xl font-semibold capitalize text-stone-900">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

function ScheduleRow({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <div>
      <dt className="text-stone-500">{label}</dt>
      <dd className="font-medium text-stone-900">{value}</dd>
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { ExerciseRenderer, type ExerciseResult } from "../../components/exercises/ExerciseRenderer";
import { evaluateKannadaRecall } from "../../domain/exercises/evaluate";
import { gradeFromAttempt, scheduleReview, type ReviewGrade } from "../../domain/revision/sm2";
import { xpForExercise } from "../../domain/progress/xp";
import type { ExerciseDto, ReviewQueueItem } from "../../services/api/tauri";
import { tauriApi } from "../../services/api/tauri";

function queueItemToExercise(item: ReviewQueueItem): ExerciseDto | null {
  if (!item.exerciseId) return null;
  return {
    id: item.exerciseId,
    exerciseType: item.exerciseType ?? "english_to_kannada",
    learningItemId: item.learningItemId,
    prompt: item.exercisePrompt ?? {},
    learningItem: {
      id: item.learningItemId,
      kannadaText: item.kannadaText,
      transliteration: item.transliteration,
      englishMeaning: item.englishMeaning,
      acceptedAnswers: item.acceptedAnswers,
    },
  };
}

export function PracticeScreen() {
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState<ReviewQueueItem[]>([]);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<ReviewQueueItem | null>(null);
  const [answer, setAnswer] = useState("");
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pendingGrade, setPendingGrade] = useState<{
    isCorrect: boolean;
    response: Record<string, unknown>;
    selfAssessed?: boolean;
  } | null>(null);

  const loadQueue = useCallback(() => {
    void tauriApi.getReviewQueue().then((items) => {
      setQueue(items);
      setActive(items[0] ?? null);
      setAnswer("");
      setFeedback(null);
      setPendingGrade(null);
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadQueue();
  }, [loadQueue]);

  const activeExercise = useMemo(
    () => (active ? queueItemToExercise(active) : null),
    [active],
  );

  async function persistReview(
    grade: ReviewGrade,
    meta: {
      isCorrect: boolean;
      response: Record<string, unknown>;
      selfAssessed?: boolean;
    },
  ) {
    if (!active?.exerciseId) return;
    const prior = await tauriApi.getItemScheduleState(active.learningItemId);
    const schedule = scheduleReview(
      {
        easeFactor: prior.easeFactor,
        intervalDays: prior.intervalDays,
        repetitions: prior.repetitions,
      },
      grade,
    );
    const xp = xpForExercise(active.exerciseType ?? "english_to_kannada", meta.isCorrect);
    await tauriApi.recordExerciseAttempt({
      exerciseId: active.exerciseId,
      learningItemId: active.learningItemId,
      isCorrect: meta.isCorrect,
      responseJson: { ...meta.response, mode: "review", grade },
      selfAssessed: meta.selfAssessed,
      xpAmount: xp,
      easeFactor: schedule.easeFactor,
      intervalDays: schedule.nextIntervalDays,
      repetitions: schedule.repetitions,
      masteryStatus: schedule.masteryStatus,
    });
    setFeedback(
      meta.isCorrect
        ? `Scheduled — next in ~${schedule.nextIntervalDays} day(s).`
        : "We'll show this again soon.",
    );
    setPendingGrade(null);
  }

  async function checkRecallAnswer() {
    if (!active?.exerciseId) return;
    const isCorrect = evaluateKannadaRecall(answer, {
      kannadaText: active.kannadaText,
      transliteration: active.transliteration,
      englishMeaning: active.englishMeaning,
      acceptedAnswers: active.acceptedAnswers,
    });
    setPendingGrade({
      isCorrect,
      response: { answer },
    });
    if (!isCorrect) {
      const grade = gradeFromAttempt({ isCorrect, wasDifficult: true });
      await persistReview(grade, { isCorrect, response: { answer } });
    } else {
      setFeedback("Pick how hard that felt:");
    }
  }

  async function onExerciseComplete(result: ExerciseResult) {
    setPendingGrade(result);
    if (!result.isCorrect) {
      const grade = gradeFromAttempt({
        isCorrect: result.isCorrect,
        wasDifficult: true,
        selfAssessedConfident: result.selfAssessed,
      });
      await persistReview(grade, result);
    } else if (result.selfAssessed === undefined) {
      setFeedback("Pick how hard that felt:");
    } else {
      const grade = gradeFromAttempt({
        isCorrect: true,
        selfAssessedConfident: result.selfAssessed,
      });
      await persistReview(grade, result);
    }
  }

  function nextItem() {
    if (!active) return;
    const rest = queue.filter((i) => i.learningItemId !== active.learningItemId);
    setQueue(rest);
    setActive(rest[0] ?? null);
    setFeedback(null);
    setAnswer("");
    setPendingGrade(null);
    if (rest.length === 0) loadQueue();
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl px-4 pb-28 pt-4">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-stone-900">Practice</h1>
      <p className="mt-1 text-stone-600">
        Daily review session — {queue.length} item{queue.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} due.
      </p>

      {active ? (
        <section className="mt-6 space-y-4 rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 ring-1 ring-stone-200">
          <p className="text-sm text-stone-500">
            Due {new Date(active.nextReviewAt).toLocaleString()} ·{" "}
            {(active.exerciseType ?? "recall").replace(/_/g, " ")}
          </p>

          {activeExercise ? (
            <ExerciseRenderer exercise={activeExercise} onComplete={(r) => void onExerciseComplete(r)} />
          ) : (
            <>
              <p className="text-lg font-medium text-stone-900">{active.englishMeaning}</p>
              <input
                className="w-full rounded-xl border border-stone-300 px-4 py-3 text-lg"
                value={answer}
                onChange={(e) => setAnswer(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Type Kannada or transliteration"
                autoCapitalize="off"
                autoCorrect="off"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                className="w-full rounded-xl bg-amber-500 py-3 font-semibold text-white disabled:opacity-50"
                disabled={!answer.trim() || !!feedback}
                onClick={() => void checkRecallAnswer()}
              >
                Check
              </button>
            </>
          )}

          {pendingGrade?.isCorrect && feedback?.startsWith("Pick") ? (
            <GradeBar onGrade={(g) => void persistReview(g, pendingGrade)} />
          ) : null}

          {feedback && !feedback.startsWith("Pick") ? (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <p className="text-sm text-stone-700">{feedback}</p>
              <p className="text-2xl font-semibold kannada">{active.kannadaText}</p>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="w-full rounded-xl bg-stone-900 py-3 font-semibold text-white"
                onClick={nextItem}
              >
                Next in queue
              </button>
            </div>
          ) : null}

          <Link
            to={`/phrase/${active.learningItemId}`}
            className="inline-block text-sm text-amber-800 underline"
          >
            Phrase details
          </Link>
        </section>
      ) : (
        <p className="mt-8 rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 text-stone-600 ring-1 ring-stone-200">
          Nothing due right now. Complete a lesson to start scheduling reviews.
        </p>
      )}

      {queue.length > 1 ? (
        <ul className="mt-6 space-y-2">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-stone-500">Also due</p>
          {queue.slice(1, 6).map((item) => (
            <li
              key={item.learningItemId}
              className="flex items-center justify-between rounded-xl bg-white px-4 py-3 text-sm ring-1 ring-stone-200"
            >
              <span className="kannada">{item.kannadaText}</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="text-amber-800"
                onClick={() => {
                  setActive(item);
                  setAnswer("");
                  setFeedback(null);
                  setPendingGrade(null);
                }}
              >
                Practice
              </button>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      ) : null}
    </div>
  );
}

function GradeBar({ onGrade }: { onGrade: (grade: ReviewGrade) => void }) {
  const grades: { label: string; grade: ReviewGrade }[] = [
    { label: "Again", grade: 1 },
    { label: "Hard", grade: 3 },
    { label: "Good", grade: 4 },
    { label: "Easy", grade: 5 },
  ];
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      {grades.map((g) => (
        <button
          key={g.grade}
          type="button"
          className="flex-1 rounded-xl border border-stone-300 py-2 text-sm font-medium"
          onClick={() => onGrade(g.grade)}
        >
          {g.label}
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { Link } from "react-router-dom";
import { save } from "@tauri-apps/plugin-dialog";
import { tauriApi } from "../../services/api/tauri";

export function ProgressScreen() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [exportStatus, setExportStatus] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    void tauriApi.getProgressStats().then(setStats);
  }, []);

  async function exportBackup() {
    setExportStatus(null);
    const file = await save({
      filters: [{ name: "Kannada Quest Backup", extensions: ["kqbackup.zip"] }],
      defaultPath: `kannada-quest-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}.kqbackup.zip`,
    });
    if (!file) return;
    try {
      const result = await tauriApi.exportLearningBackup(file);
      setExportStatus(
        `Saved backup · schema v${result.manifest.databaseSchemaVersion} · ${result.manifest.databaseChecksumSha256.slice(0, 12)}…`,
      );
    } catch (err) {
      setExportStatus(err instanceof Error ? err.message : "Export failed.");
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-6 px-4 pb-28 pt-4">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-stone-900">Progress</h1>
      <div className="grid gap-3 md:grid-cols-2">
        <StatCard label="Mastered phrases" value={stats.masteredCount ?? 0} />
        <StatCard label="Learning / reviewing" value={stats.learningCount ?? 0} />
        <StatCard
          label="Recall accuracy"
          value={`${Math.round(stats.recallAccuracyPercent ?? 0)}%`}
        />
        <StatCard label="Total attempts" value={stats.totalAttempts ?? 0} />
      </div>
      <section className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-5 ring-1 ring-stone-200">
        <h2 className="font-semibold text-stone-900">Backup</h2>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-stone-600">
          Export a portable ZIP to Files or iCloud Drive. Restore is available from Settings.
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          className="mt-4 rounded-xl bg-stone-900 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white"
          onClick={() => void exportBackup()}
        >
          Export backup
        </button>
        {exportStatus ? <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-stone-600">{exportStatus}</p> : null}
        <Link to="/settings" className="ml-3 text-sm text-amber-800 underline">
          Settings
        </Link>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function StatCard({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string | number }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-white p-4 ring-1 ring-stone-200">
      <p className="text-sm text-stone-500">{label}</p>
      <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-stone-900">{value}</p>
    </div>
  );
}
````

## File: src/services/audio/webAudioService.ts
````typescript
import { convertFileSrc, invoke, isTauri } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import type {
  AudioAssetRef,
  AudioService,
  PlaybackSpeed,
  RecordingResult,
} from "./types";
import type { AudioAssetDto } from "../api/tauri";

let activeAudio: HTMLAudioElement | null = null;

async function playAudioElement(el: HTMLAudioElement): Promise<void> {
  await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    const fail = (message: string) => {
      cleanup();
      reject(new Error(message));
    };
    const cleanup = () => {
      el.removeEventListener("error", onError);
      el.removeEventListener("canplaythrough", onReady);
    };
    const onError = () => {
      const code = el.error?.code;
      fail(
        code
          ? `Audio failed to load (media error ${code}). Rebuild and reinstall the app.`
          : "Audio failed to load.",
      );
    };
    const onReady = () => {
      cleanup();
      void el.play().then(resolve).catch(reject);
    };
    el.addEventListener("error", onError, { once: true });
    if (el.readyState >= HTMLMediaElement.HAVE_ENOUGH_DATA) {
      void el.play().then(resolve).catch(reject);
      return;
    }
    el.addEventListener("canplaythrough", onReady, { once: true });
    el.load();
  });
}

async function resolvePlayableUrl(relativePath: string): Promise<string> {
  if (isTauri()) {
    const absolute = await invoke<string>("resolve_resource_path", {
      relativePath,
    });
    return convertFileSrc(absolute);
  }
  return `/${relativePath.replace(/^content\//, "content/")}`;
}

function pickAsset(
  assets: AudioAssetDto[],
  speed: PlaybackSpeed,
  preferSource?: "human" | "ai",
): AudioAssetDto | undefined {
  const approved = assets.filter((a) => a.relativePath);
  const human = approved.filter((a) => a.source === "human" || a.source === "tts");
  const pool = preferSource === "ai" ? approved : human.length ? human : approved;
  const exact = pool.find((a) => a.speakingSpeed === speed);
  if (exact) return exact;
  if (speed === "slow") {
    return pool.find((a) => a.speakingSpeed === "slow") ?? pool[0];
  }
  return pool.find((a) => a.speakingSpeed === "normal") ?? pool[0];
}

export async function loadAudioAssets(learningItemId: string): Promise<AudioAssetDto[]> {
  if (!isTauri()) return [];
  return invoke<AudioAssetDto[]>("list_audio_assets", { learningItemId });
}

export class WebAudioService implements AudioService {
  private mediaRecorder: MediaRecorder | null = null;
  private recordChunks: BlobPart[] = [];
  private recordStartedAt = 0;

  async play(asset: AudioAssetRef, speed: PlaybackSpeed = "normal"): Promise<void> {
    if (!asset.relativePath) return;
    await this.pause();
    const url = await resolvePlayableUrl(asset.relativePath);
    const el = new Audio(url);
    el.playbackRate = speed === "slow" && asset.speakingSpeed === "normal" ? 0.82 : 1;
    activeAudio = el;
    await playAudioElement(el);
  }

  async pause(): Promise<void> {
    if (!activeAudio) return;
    activeAudio.pause();
    activeAudio = null;
  }

  async startRecording(): Promise<void> {
    if (!navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia) {
      throw new Error(
        "Microphone is unavailable in this environment. Test recording on a physical device.",
      );
    }
    const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });
    this.recordChunks = [];
    const mime =
      MediaRecorder.isTypeSupported("audio/webm;codecs=opus")
        ? "audio/webm;codecs=opus"
        : "audio/webm";
    this.mediaRecorder = new MediaRecorder(stream, { mimeType: mime });
    this.mediaRecorder.ondataavailable = (evt) => {
      if (evt.data.size > 0) this.recordChunks.push(evt.data);
    };
    this.recordStartedAt = Date.now();
    this.mediaRecorder.start();
  }

  async stopRecording(): Promise<RecordingResult> {
    if (!this.mediaRecorder) {
      throw new Error("No recording in progress.");
    }
    const recorder = this.mediaRecorder;
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      recorder.onstop = () => resolve();
      recorder.stop();
      recorder.stream.getTracks().forEach((t) => t.stop());
    });
    this.mediaRecorder = null;
    const blob = new Blob(this.recordChunks, { type: recorder.mimeType });
    const durationMs = Math.max(0, Date.now() - this.recordStartedAt);

    if (isTauri()) {
      const bytes = Array.from(new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer()));
      const meta = await invoke<{ filePath: string; durationMs: number }>(
        "write_learner_recording",
        { bytes },
      );
      return { filePath: meta.filePath, durationMs: meta.durationMs };
    }

    const filePath = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    return { filePath, durationMs };
  }

  async playLearnerRecording(filePath: string): Promise<void> {
    await this.pause();
    const src = filePath.startsWith("blob:") || filePath.startsWith("http")
      ? filePath
      : convertFileSrc(filePath);
    const el = new Audio(src);
    activeAudio = el;
    await playAudioElement(el);
  }
}

export function assetRefFromDto(
  dto: AudioAssetDto,
  speed: PlaybackSpeed,
): AudioAssetRef | null {
  if (!dto.relativePath) return null;
  return {
    learningItemId: dto.learningItemId,
    relativePath: dto.relativePath,
    source:
      dto.source === "ai" ? "ai" : dto.source === "tts" ? "tts" : "human",
    speakingSpeed: (dto.speakingSpeed as PlaybackSpeed) ?? speed,
  };
}

export function pickPlaybackAsset(
  assets: AudioAssetDto[],
  speed: PlaybackSpeed,
): AudioAssetDto | undefined {
  return pickAsset(assets, speed);
}
````

````rust
use rusqlite::Connection;

pub const LATEST_VERSION: i32 = 3;

const MIGRATION_001: &str = include_str!("../../migrations/001_initial.sql");
const MIGRATION_002: &str = include_str!("../../migrations/002_item_repetitions.sql");
const MIGRATION_003: &str = include_str!("../../migrations/003_audio_tts_source.sql");

pub fn run(conn: &Connection) -> Result<(), String> {
    let current: i32 = conn
        .query_row(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='schema_migrations'",
            [],
            |_| Ok(()),
        )
        .ok()
        .and_then(|_| {
            conn.query_row(
                "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations",
                [],
                |row| row.get(0),
            )
            .ok()
        })
        .unwrap_or(0);

    if current < 1 {
        conn.execute_batch(MIGRATION_001)
            .map_err(|e| format!("migration 001 failed: {e}"))?;
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_migrations (version) VALUES (1)",
            [],
        )
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }

    if current < 2 {
        conn.execute_batch(MIGRATION_002)
            .map_err(|e| format!("migration 002 failed: {e}"))?;
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_migrations (version) VALUES (2)",
            [],
        )
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }

    if current < 3 {
        conn.execute_batch(MIGRATION_003)
            .map_err(|e| format!("migration 003 failed: {e}"))?;
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO schema_migrations (version) VALUES (3)",
            [],
        )
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    }

    Ok(())
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use rusqlite::Connection;

    #[test]
    fn migrations_apply_idempotently() {
        let conn = Connection::open_in_memory().unwrap();
        run(&conn).unwrap();
        run(&conn).unwrap();
        let count: i64 = conn
            .query_row("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learning_items", [], |r| r.get(0))
            .unwrap();
        assert_eq!(count, 0);
    }
}
````

## File: src-tauri/src/db/mod.rs
````rust
pub mod migrations;

use rusqlite::Connection;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Mutex;

pub struct DbState {
    pub conn: Mutex<Connection>,
    pub path: PathBuf,
}

impl DbState {
    pub fn open(path: &Path) -> Result<Self, String> {
        if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
            std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        }
        let conn = Self::connect_and_migrate(path)?;
        Ok(Self {
            conn: Mutex::new(conn),
            path: path.to_path_buf(),
        })
    }

    fn connect_and_migrate(path: &Path) -> Result<Connection, String> {
        let conn = Connection::open(path).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        conn.execute_batch("PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;")
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        migrations::run(&conn)?;
        Ok(conn)
    }

    /// Re-open the database file from disk (required after external restore over live path).
    pub fn reopen(&self) -> Result<(), String> {
        let conn = Self::connect_and_migrate(&self.path)?;
        let mut guard = self.conn.lock().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        *guard = conn;
        Ok(())
    }

    pub fn schema_version(&self) -> Result<i32, String> {
        let conn = self.conn.lock().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        let version: i32 = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version), 0) FROM schema_migrations",
                [],
                |row| row.get(0),
            )
            .unwrap_or(0);
        Ok(version.max(migrations::LATEST_VERSION))
    }

    pub fn integrity_check(&self) -> Result<String, String> {
        let conn = self.conn.lock().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        conn.query_row("PRAGMA integrity_check", [], |row| row.get(0))
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    }
}

pub fn with_conn<T, F>(state: &DbState, f: F) -> Result<T, String>
where
    F: FnOnce(&Connection) -> Result<T, String>,
{
    let conn = state.conn.lock().map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
    f(&conn)
}
````

## File: docs/DEVELOPER_SETUP.md
````markdown
# Developer setup

Node 22+, **rustup** (not Homebrew Rust alone), **Xcode.app** for iOS, `APPLE_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM` in `.env` for device builds.

## Desktop

```bash
npm install
npm run test         # Vitest (TDD default — see constitution/techstack §6)
npm run dev          # UI only
npm run tauri dev    # desktop shell
```

```bash
cd src-tauri && cargo test
npm run content:validate
npm run content:build   # specs → beginner-path.json + macOS TTS audio
```

Curriculum authoring: [`content/curriculum/specs/README.md`](../content/curriculum/specs/README.md).

To merge a newer curriculum into an existing database (keeps attempts, XP, streak):

```bash
npm run content:import -- --db "$HOME/Library/Application Support/com.kannadaquest.app/learner.sqlite"
```

Optional: `--force` re-applies the bundle even when versions match. Fresh installs still import on `init_app` when the DB is empty or `content_version` lags the bundled JSON.

## iOS

**Fish** — add once to `~/.config/fish/config.fish` so Tauri sees rustup:

```fish
source $HOME/.cargo/env.fish 2>/dev/null; or true
fish_add_path -m $HOME/.local/bin
```

**bash/zsh:** `source "$HOME/.cargo/env"` and ensure `$HOME/.cargo/bin` is on `PATH`.

```bash
npm run ios:setup
cp .env.example .env    # set APPLE_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM
npm run test
npm run ios:dev         # simulator or connected device
```

Simulator-only CI build:

```bash
npm run ios:build -- --ci --target aarch64-sim
```

If **simctl** exits 72: install Xcode.app, then `sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer`.

If **device signing** fails: Xcode → Settings → Accounts → sign in; open `src-tauri/gen/apple/kannada-quest.xcodeproj` → automatically manage signing for `kannada-quest_iOS`.

## Device smoke test (optional)

On a physical iPhone/iPad when you care about mic, Files, and speakers—not simulator alone.

| Check | ☐ |
|-------|---|
| Launch, first-run import, lesson offline (airplane mode) | |
| Progress after force quit; Kannada script | |
| Audio normal/slow; mic on listen-repeat | |
| Backup export/import via Files | |
| iPad portrait + landscape | |

## Docs

| Doc | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| [`vision.md`](vision.md) | Product vision |
| [`constitution/mission.md`](constitution/mission.md) | Mission and boundaries |
| [`constitution/techstack.md`](constitution/techstack.md) | Architecture, **TDD** (§6) |
| [`constitution/roadmap.md`](constitution/roadmap.md) | Phases and priorities |
| [`ARCHITECTURE.md`](ARCHITECTURE.md) | Layer summary |
````

````python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Regenerate content/curriculum/beginner-path.json from JSON unit specs."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
OUT = ROOT / "content" / "curriculum" / "beginner-path.json"

sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "scripts" / "curriculum"))

from assemble import assemble_bundle  # noqa: E402
from load import load_curriculum_data  # noqa: E402


def build() -> dict:
    return assemble_bundle(load_curriculum_data())


def main() -> None:
    bundle = build()
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(bundle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(
        f"Wrote {OUT.name}: {len(bundle['learning_items'])} items, "
        f"{len(bundle['lessons'])} lessons, {len(bundle['exercises'])} exercises "
        f"(v{bundle['content_version']})"
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
````

````bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Phase 0: install everything that does NOT require Apple ID / sudo password.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
export PATH="${HOME}/.cargo/bin:${HOME}/.local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:${PATH}"

echo "==> Rust (rustup + iOS targets)"
if ! command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable
fi
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "${HOME}/.cargo/env"
rustup target add aarch64-apple-ios aarch64-apple-ios-sim x86_64-apple-ios >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

echo "==> Homebrew iOS helpers"
brew list xcodegen >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install xcodegen
brew list libimobiledevice >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install libimobiledevice
brew list cocoapods >/dev/null 2>&1 || brew install cocoapods

if ! command -v xcodes >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "==> xcodes CLI (Xcode downloader)"
  mkdir -p "${HOME}/.local/bin"
  XCODES_TGZ="/tmp/xcodes-cli.tgz"
  curl -fsSL -o "${XCODES_TGZ}" \
    "https://github.com/XcodesOrg/xcodes/releases/download/2.2.0/xcodes-2.2.0.macos.arm64.bottle.tar.gz"
  rm -rf /tmp/xcodes-extract
  mkdir -p /tmp/xcodes-extract
  tar -xzf "${XCODES_TGZ}" -C /tmp/xcodes-extract
  install -m 755 /tmp/xcodes-extract/xcodes/2.2.0/bin/xcodes "${HOME}/.local/bin/xcodes"
fi

echo "==> Tauri iOS project"
cd "${ROOT}"
npm install
npm run ios:init
if [[ -f "${ROOT}/src-tauri/gen/apple/project.yml" ]]; then
  echo "==> Regenerate Xcode project (project.yml → .xcodeproj)"
  bash "${ROOT}/scripts/ios-xcodegen.sh"
fi

if [[ ! -d "/Applications/Xcode.app" ]]; then
  echo ""
  echo "⚠️  Full Xcode is not installed yet (only Command Line Tools)."
  echo "    Install Xcode (one of these):"
  echo "      1) App Store:  open \"macappstore://apps.apple.com/app/xcode/id497799835\""
  echo "      2) CLI:        xcodes signin   # then:  xcodes install 27.2"
  echo "    After install: sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer"
  echo "    Accept license: sudo xcodebuild -license accept"
  exit 2
fi

if [[ "$(xcode-select -p)" != "/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer" ]]; then
  echo "==> Pointing xcode-select at Xcode.app (may prompt for password)"
  sudo xcode-select -s /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer
fi

if ! security find-identity -v -p codesigning 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Apple Development"; then
  echo ""
  echo "⚠️  No Apple Development certificate yet."
  echo "    Open Xcode → Settings → Accounts → add Apple ID → Download Manual Profiles."
  echo "    Then set APPLE_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM in .env (see .env.example)."
  exit 2
fi

echo "==> Toolchain ready."
echo "    fish: source \$HOME/.cargo/env.fish && set -x APPLE_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM <team> && npm run ios:dev"
echo "    (see docs/DEVELOPER_SETUP.md)"
````

````rust
use crate::content::import::{bundled_curriculum_json, import_if_newer, ContentImportOutcome};
use crate::db::DbState;
use serde::Serialize;
use tauri::State;

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct AppInitResult {
    pub schema_version: i32,
    pub content_items: usize,
    pub content_imported: bool,
    pub integrity_ok: bool,
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn init_app(state: State<DbState>) -> Result<AppInitResult, String> {
    let imported = crate::db::with_conn(&state, |conn| {
        match import_if_newer(conn, bundled_curriculum_json())? {
        ContentImportOutcome::Imported { items, .. } => Ok(Some(items)),
        ContentImportOutcome::NoChange { .. } => Ok(None),
        }
    })?;

    let integrity = state.integrity_check()?;
    Ok(AppInitResult {
        schema_version: state.schema_version()?,
        content_items: imported.unwrap_or(0),
        content_imported: imported.is_some(),
        integrity_ok: integrity == "ok",
    })
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn complete_onboarding(state: State<DbState>, display_name: Option<String>) -> Result<(), String> {
    crate::db::with_conn(&state, |conn| {
        conn.execute(
            "UPDATE learner_profile SET display_name = ?1, onboarding_complete = 1, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = 'default'",
            [display_name.as_deref().unwrap_or("Learner")],
        )
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
        Ok(())
    })
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn update_learner_profile(
    state: State<DbState>,
    daily_goal_xp: Option<i32>,
) -> Result<(), String> {
    if let Some(goal) = daily_goal_xp {
        if !(10..=500).contains(&goal) {
            return Err("daily goal must be between 10 and 500 XP".to_string());
        }
        crate::db::with_conn(&state, |conn| {
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE learner_profile SET daily_goal_xp = ?1, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE id = 'default'",
                [goal],
            )
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
            Ok(())
        })?;
    }
    Ok(())
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn get_learner_profile(state: State<DbState>) -> Result<serde_json::Value, String> {
    crate::db::with_conn(&state, |conn| {
        conn.query_row(
            "SELECT display_name, daily_goal_xp, onboarding_complete FROM learner_profile WHERE id = 'default'",
            [],
            |row| {
                Ok(serde_json::json!({
                    "displayName": row.get::<_, Option<String>>(0)?,
                    "dailyGoalXp": row.get::<_, i32>(1)?,
                    "onboardingComplete": row.get::<_, i32>(2)? == 1,
                }))
            },
        )
        .map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    })
}
````

````rust
use crate::db::DbState;
use serde::Serialize;
use tauri::State;

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct HomeSummary {
    pub streak_days: i32,
    pub today_xp: i32,
    pub daily_goal_xp: i32,
    pub due_reviews: i32,
    pub continue_lesson_id: Option<String>,
    pub continue_lesson_title: Option<String>,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct LevelSummary {
    pub id: String,
    pub ordinal: i32,
    pub title: String,
    pub description: Option<String>,
    pub unit_count: i32,
    pub completed_lessons: i32,
    pub total_lessons: i32,
}

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct LessonSummary {
    pub id: String,
    pub ordinal: i32,
    pub title: String,
    pub description: Option<String>,

}

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]

    pub english_meaning: String,
    pub literal_translation: Option<String>,

}

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct ExerciseDto {

#[derive(Serialize)]
#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
pub struct LessonDetail {

    pub title: String,
    pub description: Option<String>,
    pub exercises: Vec<ExerciseDto>,
}

/// Consecutive calendar days with daily XP goal met, ending today if met or yesterday otherwise.
fn consecutive_goal_streak(conn: &rusqlite::Connection) -> Result<i32, String> {
    let today_met: i32 = conn
        .query_row(
            "SELECT COALESCE(goal_met, 0) FROM daily_activity WHERE activity_date = date('now', 'localtime')",
            [],
            |row| row.get(0),
        )
        .unwrap_or(0);
    let mut offset = if today_met == 1 { 0 } else { 1 };
    let mut streak = 0i32;
    loop {
        let met: i32 = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT COALESCE(goal_met, 0) FROM daily_activity
                 WHERE activity_date = date('now', '-' || ?1 || ' days', 'localtime')",
                [offset],
                |row| row.get(0),
            )
            .unwrap_or(0);
        if met == 0 {
            break;
        }
        streak += 1;
        offset += 1;
        if offset > 400 {
            break;
        }
    }
    Ok(streak)
}

fn parse_accepted_answers(raw: Option<String>) -> Vec<String> {
    raw.and_then(|s| serde_json::from_str(&s).ok()).unwrap_or_default()
}

fn learning_item_from_row(
    row: &rusqlite::Row<'_>,
    offset: usize,
) -> Result<LearningItemDto, rusqlite::Error> {
    Ok(LearningItemDto {
        id: row.get(offset)?,
        kannada_text: row.get(offset + 1)?,
        transliteration: row.get(offset + 2)?,
        english_meaning: row.get(offset + 3)?,
        literal_translation: row.get(offset + 4)?,
        context_note: row.get(offset + 5)?,
        accepted_answers: parse_accepted_answers(row.get(offset + 6)?),
    })
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn get_home_summary(state: State<DbState>) -> Result<HomeSummary, String> {
    crate::db::with_conn(&state, |conn| {
        let daily_goal: i32 = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT daily_goal_xp FROM learner_profile WHERE id = 'default'",
                [],
                |row| row.get(0),
            )
            .unwrap_or(50);

        let today_xp: i32 = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT COALESCE(xp_earned, 0) FROM daily_activity WHERE activity_date = date('now', 'localtime')",
                [],
                |row| row.get(0),
            )
            .unwrap_or(0);

        let due_reviews: i32 = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_schedule WHERE next_review_at <= datetime('now', 'localtime')",
                [],
                |row| row.get(0),
            )
            .unwrap_or(0);

        let streak_days = consecutive_goal_streak(conn)?;

        let in_progress = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT l.id, l.title FROM lesson_attempts la
                 JOIN lessons l ON l.id = la.lesson_id
                 WHERE la.completed_at IS NULL
                 ORDER BY la.started_at DESC LIMIT 1",
                [],
                |row| Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?)),
            )
            .ok();

        let next_lesson = in_progress.or_else(|| {
            conn.query_row(
                "SELECT l.id, l.title FROM lessons l
                 LEFT JOIN lesson_attempts la ON la.lesson_id = l.id AND la.completed_at IS NOT NULL
                 WHERE la.id IS NULL
                 ORDER BY l.ordinal LIMIT 1",
                [],
                |row| Ok((row.get::<_, String>(0)?, row.get::<_, String>(1)?)),
            )
            .ok()
        });

        Ok(HomeSummary {
            streak_days,
            today_xp,
            daily_goal_xp: daily_goal,
            due_reviews,
            continue_lesson_id: next_lesson.as_ref().map(|(id, _)| id.clone()),
            continue_lesson_title: next_lesson.map(|(_, t)| t),
        })
    })
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn list_levels(state: State<DbState>) -> Result<Vec<LevelSummary>, String> {
    crate::db::with_conn(&state, |conn| {
        let mut stmt = conn
            .prepare(
                "SELECT lv.id, lv.ordinal, lv.title, lv.description,
                        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM units u WHERE u.level_id = lv.id) AS unit_count,
                        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lessons l
                           JOIN units u ON u.id = l.unit_id
                           WHERE u.level_id = lv.id) AS total_lessons,
                        (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson_attempts la
                           JOIN lessons l ON l.id = la.lesson_id
                           JOIN units u ON u.id = l.unit_id
                           WHERE u.level_id = lv.id AND la.completed_at IS NOT NULL) AS completed_lessons
                 FROM levels lv ORDER BY lv.ordinal",
            )
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let rows = stmt
            .query_map([], |row| {
                Ok(LevelSummary {
                    id: row.get(0)?,
                    ordinal: row.get(1)?,
                    title: row.get(2)?,
                    description: row.get(3)?,
                    unit_count: row.get(4)?,
                    completed_lessons: row.get(6)?,
                    total_lessons: row.get(5)?,
                })
            })
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        rows.collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>().map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    })
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn list_lessons_for_level(
    state: State<DbState>,
    level_id: String,
) -> Result<Vec<LessonSummary>, String> {
    crate::db::with_conn(&state, |conn| {
        let mut stmt = conn
            .prepare(
                "SELECT l.id, l.ordinal, l.title, l.description, l.estimated_minutes,
                        CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM lesson_attempts la WHERE la.lesson_id = l.id AND la.completed_at IS NOT NULL
                        ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed
                 FROM lessons l
                 JOIN units u ON u.id = l.unit_id
                 WHERE u.level_id = ?1
                 ORDER BY u.ordinal, l.ordinal",
            )
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let rows = stmt
            .query_map([&level_id], |row| {
                Ok(LessonSummary {
                    id: row.get(0)?,
                    ordinal: row.get(1)?,
                    title: row.get(2)?,
                    description: row.get(3)?,
                    estimated_minutes: row.get(4)?,
                    completed: row.get::<_, i32>(5)? == 1,
                })
            })
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        rows.collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>().map_err(|e| e.to_string())
    })
}

#[tauri::command]
pub fn get_lesson_detail(state: State<DbState>, lesson_id: String) -> Result<LessonDetail, String> {
    crate::db::with_conn(&state, |conn| {
        let (title, description): (String, Option<String>) = conn
            .query_row(
                "SELECT title, description FROM lessons WHERE id = ?1",
                [&lesson_id],
                |row| Ok((row.get(0)?, row.get(1)?)),
            )
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let mut stmt = conn
            .prepare(
                "SELECT e.id, e.exercise_type, e.learning_item_id, e.prompt_json,
                        li.id, li.kannada_text, li.transliteration, li.english_meaning,
                        li.literal_translation, li.context_note, li.accepted_answers
                 FROM exercise_definitions e
                 LEFT JOIN learning_items li ON li.id = e.learning_item_id
                 WHERE e.lesson_id = ?1
                 ORDER BY e.sort_order",
            )
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        let exercises = stmt
            .query_map([&lesson_id], |row| {
                let prompt: serde_json::Value =
                    serde_json::from_str(row.get::<_, String>(3)?.as_str()).unwrap_or_default();
                let learning_item = if row.get::<_, Option<String>>(4)?.is_some() {
                    Some(learning_item_from_row(row, 4)?)
                } else {
                    None
                };
                Ok(ExerciseDto {
                    id: row.get(0)?,
                    exercise_type: row.get(1)?,
                    learning_item_id: row.get(2)?,
                    prompt,
                    learning_item,
                })
            })
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?
            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;

        Ok(LessonDetail {
            id: lesson_id,
            title,
            description,
            exercises,
        })
    })
}
````
